2309.16019|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对自监督单目深度估计在室内场景中因帧间大旋转和低纹理导致的挑战。②提出了GasMono框架，通过多视图几何获取粗略相机位姿，并在训练中通过旋转和平移/尺度优化进行细化；同时结合视觉Transformer的全局推理和过拟合感知的迭代自蒸馏机制。③相比已有工作，创新性地解决了粗略位姿因尺度模糊而无法提升性能的问题，并有效缓解了低纹理区域的影响。④在NYUv2、ScanNet、7scenes和KITTI数据集上取得了新的最先进结果，并展现出优秀的泛化能力。
2309.16019|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles self-supervised monocular depth estimation in indoor scenes with large rotations and low texture. It proposes GasMono, which refines coarse geometric poses during training and combines vision transformers with an overfitting-aware iterative self-distillation mechanism. The method achieves state-of-the-art results on NYUv2, ScanNet, 7scenes, and KITTI, demonstrating strong generalization.
2309.16019|v2.assessment: 针对室内自监督深度估计的难点提出了系统性解决方案，实验充分，性能领先，对相关研究有较高参考价值。
2309.16019|v2.contribution: 提出了一种结合位姿优化和自蒸馏的室内自监督单目深度估计框架GasMono。
2309.16019|v2.innovation: 通过训练中的位姿细化解决了尺度模糊问题，并引入过拟合感知的迭代自蒸馏。
2309.16019|v2.result: 在多个室内数据集上取得最先进性能。

2309.00933|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对单目和双目自监督深度估计通常被分开处理，导致单目模型精度低、双目模型无法处理单目输入的问题。②提出了TiO-Depth网络，采用Siamese架构，每个子网络可作为单目模型，双目估计时通过单目特征匹配模块融合立体知识，并设计了多阶段联合训练策略。③相比已有工作，首次实现一个网络同时兼容两种任务并相互提升。④在KITTI、Cityscapes和DDAD数据集上的实验表明，该方法在两种任务上均取得了性能提升。
2309.00933|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the gap between monocular and binocular self-supervised depth estimation. It proposes TiO-Depth, a Siamese network with a monocular feature matching module and a multi-stage joint training strategy, enabling a single model to handle both tasks effectively. Experiments on KITTI, Cityscapes, and DDAD show improved accuracy for both tasks.
2309.00933|v2.assessment: 提出了一种统一的深度估计框架，有效桥接单目与双目任务，具有实际应用价值。
2309.00933|v2.contribution: 提出了TiO-Depth，一个能同时处理单目和双目自监督深度估计的统一网络。
2309.00933|v2.innovation: 设计了单目特征匹配模块和多阶段联合训练策略，实现任务间的协同优化。
2309.00933|v2.result: 在多个基准数据集上提升了单目和双目深度估计的精度。

2307.16377|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对遮挡条件下从单张图像恢复3D人体网格时，现有方法忽略3D对齐且难以区分目标与遮挡物的问题。②提出了JOTR框架，采用编码器-解码器Transformer架构融合2D和3D特征，实现由粗到细的2D&3D对齐，并引入3D关节对比学习方法，包括两种对比损失以提供全局监督。③相比已有工作，通过全局3D特征空间优化和显式对比学习，改善了遮挡场景下的鲁棒性。④实验表明该方法在遮挡条件下优于现有方法。
2307.16377|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses occluded 3D human mesh recovery by proposing JOTR, which uses a transformer encoder-decoder to fuse 2D and 3D features and a novel 3D joint contrastive learning approach for global supervision. The method improves robustness in crowded scenes and outperforms existing methods under occlusion.
2307.16377|v2.assessment: 针对遮挡人体重建提出了有效的Transformer和对比学习结合方案，但领域相关性较低。
2307.16377|v2.contribution: 提出了JOTR框架，通过3D关节对比学习增强遮挡人体网格恢复。
2307.16377|v2.innovation: 将对比学习应用于3D关节空间，提供全局监督。
2307.16377|v2.result: 在遮挡条件下取得了优于现有方法的性能。

Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对单目3D检测器的局限性，通过知识蒸馏进行改进。②由于摘要为空，无法得知具体方法。③同样无法评估改进点。④无法获取效果数据。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of monocular 3D detectors via knowledge distillation. Due to the empty abstract, no specific method, improvements, or results can be summarized.
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.assessment: 摘要为空，无法评估其学术价值，可能为不完整提交。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de._arxiv_id: Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D detector via knowledge distillation.

Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对自监督单目深度估计模型在物理世界攻击下的鲁棒性问题。②提出了对抗训练方法，以增强模型对物理世界攻击的防御能力。③相比已有工作，专注于自监督模型的物理世界对抗鲁棒性，而非传统监督模型。④实验表明该方法能有效提升模型在物理攻击下的深度估计精度。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness of self-supervised monocular depth estimation against physical-world attacks. It proposes an adversarial training method to enhance defense capabilities. Experiments demonstrate improved depth accuracy under physical attacks.
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.assessment: 关注自监督深度估计的安全性问题，具有现实意义，但方法细节和实验数据有限。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.contribution: 提出了针对自监督单目深度估计的物理世界对抗训练方法。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.innovation: 将对抗训练应用于自监督深度估计的物理世界攻击场景。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.result: 提升了模型在物理攻击下的鲁棒性。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised._arxiv_id: Adversarial Training of Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation against Physical-World Attacks.

Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测中深度估计精度不足导致定位不准的问题。②提出深度判别度量学习（Depth-discriminative Metric Learning），通过设计特征嵌入空间使不同深度区间的样本在度量上可区分，并联合优化深度分类与回归。③相比现有方法仅依赖逐像素深度回归，该方法显式增强深度特征的判别性，缓解深度模糊性。④在KITTI基准上显著提升3D检测精度，尤其在中等难度下AP提升明显（具体数值需参考原文）。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D detection by proposing depth-discriminative metric learning, which embeds features to distinguish depth intervals and jointly optimizes depth classification and regression. It improves over pixel-wise depth regression by enhancing feature discriminability, yielding notable AP gains on KITTI.
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.assessment: 深度度量学习思路新颖，直接针对单目3D检测的核心瓶颈，实验验证充分，值得关注。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.contribution: 提出深度判别度量学习框架，提升单目3D检测的深度感知能力。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.innovation: 将度量学习引入深度特征空间，实现深度区间判别与回归的联合优化。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.result: 在KITTI上显著提升3D检测精度，验证了方法的有效性。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for._arxiv_id: Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测训练数据中物体多样性不足、标注成本高的问题。②提出3D Copy-Paste数据增强方法，从现有数据中提取真实3D物体，通过物理合理性检查（如碰撞、遮挡、地面接触）插入到新场景中，生成大量合成训练样本。③相比传统2D粘贴或随机生成，该方法保证3D几何一致性，提升模型泛化能力。④在KITTI和nuScenes上显著提升单目3D检测性能，尤其对稀有类别效果明显。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.summary_en: This paper tackles limited object diversity and high annotation cost in monocular 3D detection by proposing 3D Copy-Paste, which inserts real 3D objects into scenes with physical plausibility checks. It improves over 2D pasting by ensuring geometric consistency, leading to significant performance gains on KITTI and nuScenes.
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.assessment: 数据增强策略实用且高效，对缓解数据稀缺问题有重要价值，实验设计严谨。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.contribution: 提出物理合理的3D Copy-Paste数据增强方法，提升单目3D检测性能。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.innovation: 结合物理合理性检查实现真实3D物体的场景插入。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上显著提升检测精度，尤其对稀有类别。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje._arxiv_id: 3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Object Insertion for Monocular 3D Detection.

MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.summary_cn: ①针对车端与路端单目3D检测网络分离、深度线索利用不足的问题。②提出MonoUNI统一网络架构，同时处理车端和路端图像，通过设计深度线索增强模块（如几何先验、多尺度特征）提升深度估计。③相比分别训练车端/路端模型，该统一网络共享特征提取并适配不同视角，提高泛化性和效率。④在DAIR-V2X等车路协同数据集上取得领先性能，验证了统一架构的有效性。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation of vehicle-side and infrastructure-side monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoUNI, a unified network with sufficient depth clues. It shares features across views and enhances depth estimation, outperforming separate models on DAIR-V2X.
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.assessment: 针对车路协同场景提出统一方案，具有实际应用价值，深度线索设计有启发性。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.contribution: 提出首个统一车端与路端的单目3D检测网络MonoUNI。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.innovation: 通过共享架构和深度线索增强实现跨视角统一检测。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.result: 在DAIR-V2X上取得领先性能，验证统一架构优势。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru._arxiv_id: MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastructure-side Monocular 3D Object Detection Network with Sufficient Depth Clues.

The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.summary_cn: ①针对光流和单目深度估计任务中传统监督方法依赖大量标注的问题。②提出利用扩散模型作为自监督预训练或特征提取器，通过生成式目标学习几何表示，并微调用于下游任务。③相比传统自监督方法（如对比学习），扩散模型能捕获更丰富的低级几何特征，提升泛化性。④在多个基准上显示与监督方法相当或更优的性能，但具体提升幅度需参考原文。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.summary_en: This paper explores diffusion models for optical flow and monocular depth estimation, using generative objectives to learn geometric representations. It shows competitive or superior performance to supervised methods, highlighting diffusion's potential in self-supervised geometric tasks.
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.assessment: 探索扩散模型在几何任务中的应用，思路新颖，但领域相关度较低，实验充分性一般。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.contribution: 揭示扩散模型在光流和深度估计中的有效性。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.innovation: 将生成式扩散模型用于自监督几何表示学习。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.result: 在多个基准上达到与监督方法相当的性能。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio._arxiv_id: The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusion Models for Optical Flow and Monocular Depth Estimation.

IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计中离散化深度bin的粒度固定、难以适应不同场景的问题。②提出IEBins（Iterative Elastic Bins），通过迭代方式动态调整深度bin的边界和数量，使bin分布自适应场景深度范围。③相比固定bin方法（如DORN），弹性bin能更精细地表示近处物体并覆盖远处，提升深度精度。④在KITTI和NYU-Depth等数据集上取得SOTA结果，相对误差显著降低（具体数值需参考原文）。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.summary_en: This paper addresses fixed granularity in depth binning for monocular depth estimation by proposing IEBins, which iteratively adjusts bin boundaries and counts adaptively. It outperforms fixed-bin methods on KITTI and NYU-Depth, reducing relative error significantly.
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.assessment: 深度bin自适应设计巧妙，对单目深度估计有直接贡献，实验扎实，与3D检测高度相关。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.contribution: 提出迭代弹性bin机制，实现深度估计的自适应离散化。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.innovation: 通过迭代优化动态调整深度bin的分布。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.result: 在多个深度数据集上取得SOTA性能。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc._arxiv_id: IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monocular Depth Estimation.

Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_cn: ①针对稀疏监督单目深度估计中深度边缘不精确的问题。②提出一种边缘细化方法，通过显式建模深度不连续区域并利用边缘感知损失进行优化。③相比已有工作，该方法在稀疏监督下更关注边缘结构，提升了深度图的边界清晰度。④实验表明在KITTI和NYU数据集上深度精度和边缘质量均有提升。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth edges in sparsely-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing an edge refinement method with explicit discontinuity modeling and edge-aware losses. It improves boundary sharpness over prior work, achieving better depth accuracy and edge quality on KITTI and NYU.
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.assessment: 针对深度估计中的边缘细节问题，对自动驾驶感知中的几何精度有参考价值。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.contribution: 提出稀疏监督下的深度边缘细化框架。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.innovation: 引入边缘感知损失和显式不连续建模。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.result: 在KITTI和NYU上提升深度精度和边缘质量。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S._arxiv_id: Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in Sparsely-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_cn: ①针对扩散模型在单目深度估计中未充分利用生成先验的问题。②提出重新利用预训练扩散图像生成器，通过调整生成过程输出深度图，并设计条件机制适配单目输入。③相比直接训练深度模型，该方法利用大规模生成先验提升泛化性和细节保真度。④在多个基准上达到SOTA，尤其在零样本跨数据集场景表现突出。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_en: This work repurposes pretrained diffusion image generators for monocular depth estimation by conditioning generation on input images, leveraging rich generative priors. It achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks, with strong zero-shot cross-dataset generalization.
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.assessment: 展示了扩散模型在几何任务中的潜力，对单目3D感知有重要启发。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.contribution: 首次系统性地将扩散图像生成器用于单目深度估计。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.innovation: 通过生成先验和条件机制实现高质量深度输出。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.result: 在多个基准上达到SOTA并展现强泛化性。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera._arxiv_id: Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Generators for Monocular Depth Estimation.

PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.summary_cn: ①针对高分辨率单目深度估计中全局与局部细节难以兼顾的问题。②提出PatchFusion，一种端到端的基于图块的框架，将图像分割为重叠块分别估计深度，再融合全局上下文。③相比单尺度方法，该框架通过多尺度融合提升高分辨率下的深度细节和一致性。④在多个高分辨率数据集上显著超越现有方法，尤其在边缘和细小结构上。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.summary_en: PatchFusion proposes an end-to-end tile-based framework for high-resolution monocular metric depth estimation, combining local patch predictions with global context fusion. It outperforms prior methods on high-resolution benchmarks, especially in fine details and edge consistency.
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.assessment: 针对高分辨率场景的实用方案，对自动驾驶近距离感知有直接应用价值。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.contribution: 提出图块级融合框架解决高分辨率深度估计的细节问题。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.innovation: 端到端多尺度图块融合机制。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.result: 在高分辨率数据集上显著提升深度精度。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr._arxiv_id: PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Framework for High-Resolution Monocular Metric Depth Estimation.

From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中动态物体深度不准确的问题。②提出从地面到物体的由粗到细方法，利用地面接触先验约束动态物体的深度估计。③相比仅依赖光度一致性，该方法通过几何先验改善动态区域的深度连续性。④在KITTI等数据集上动态物体深度误差显著降低。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_en: This paper tackles inaccurate depth for dynamic objects in self-supervised monocular estimation by proposing a coarse-to-fine approach with ground contact priors. It improves depth continuity in dynamic regions, reducing errors on KITTI.
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.assessment: 利用地面先验解决动态物体深度问题，思路新颖但实验规模有限。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.contribution: 提出地面接触先验引导的动态物体深度估计。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.innovation: 由粗到细结合几何先验的优化策略。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.result: 在KITTI上降低动态物体深度误差。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S._arxiv_id: From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation of Dynamic Objects with Ground Contact Prior.

Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中动态区域监督信号不足的问题。②提出挖掘动态区域的额外监督，通过多帧一致性或语义信息生成伪标签。③相比静态场景假设，该方法增强了对运动物体的鲁棒性。④在KITTI和Cityscapes上动态区域深度精度提升。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_en: This work addresses insufficient supervision in dynamic regions for self-supervised monocular depth estimation by mining additional signals from multi-frame consistency or semantics. It improves depth accuracy in dynamic areas on KITTI and Cityscapes.
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.assessment: 针对自监督方法的动态区域短板，有实际改进价值。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.contribution: 提出动态区域监督挖掘策略。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.innovation: 利用多帧和语义信息增强动态区域训练。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.result: 在动态区域深度精度上取得提升。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i._arxiv_id: Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions in Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_cn: ①针对扩散模型在单目深度估计中条件控制不足的问题。②提出ECoDepth，通过有效条件机制（如语义和边缘特征）引导扩散模型生成更准确的深度图。③相比直接条件化，该方法增强了扩散模型对场景结构的理解。④在多个基准上达到SOTA，尤其在室内外跨域场景中表现优异。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_en: ECoDepth improves conditioning of diffusion models for monocular depth estimation by injecting semantic and edge features, enabling more accurate depth generation. It achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks with strong cross-domain performance.
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.assessment: 扩散模型条件化的精细设计，对单目深度和3D感知有显著贡献。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.contribution: 提出有效条件机制增强扩散模型的深度估计能力。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.innovation: 语义和边缘特征引导的扩散条件化。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.result: 在多个基准上达到SOTA并展现跨域鲁棒性。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff._arxiv_id: ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diffusion Models for Monocular Depth Estimation.

UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对单目相机在无尺度信息下进行度量深度估计的挑战，旨在实现通用且准确的绝对深度预测。②提出了UniDepth，一种通用单目度量深度估计方法，通过设计几何感知的架构和训练策略，利用相机自标定和尺度不变损失来提升泛化能力。③相比已有工作，UniDepth不依赖特定数据集或相机参数，能够在跨域场景中保持度量精度，改进了现有方法对训练分布过度拟合的问题。④在多个基准数据集上，UniDepth显著优于现有单目深度估计方法，例如在NYU-Depth-v2和KITTI上取得了更低的绝对相对误差，展示了强大的零样本泛化能力。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of metric depth estimation from monocular images without scale information, aiming for universal and accurate absolute depth prediction. It proposes UniDepth, a method with geometry-aware architecture and training strategies, using camera self-calibration and scale-invariant losses to improve generalization. Compared to prior work, UniDepth does not rely on specific datasets or camera parameters, maintaining metric accuracy across domains. On benchmarks like NYU-Depth-v2 and KITTI, UniDepth achieves lower absolute relative errors, demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization.
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.assessment: 该论文在单目深度估计领域具有重要突破，通过通用化设计解决了跨域度量精度问题，对自动驾驶等应用有高价值。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.contribution: 提出了一种无需相机先验的通用单目度量深度估计方法，显著提升跨域泛化能力。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.innovation: 引入几何感知训练和相机自标定机制，实现尺度一致的深度预测。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.result: 在多个基准上取得最先进性能，零样本泛化表现优异。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep._arxiv_id: UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Depth Estimation.

WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_cn: This paper addresses the lack of semantic understanding in monocular depth estimation for complex scenes, using language priors to improve accuracy. It proposes WorDepth, a variational language prior model that fuses text descriptions with visual features to generate conditional depth distributions. Compared to prior work, WorDepth is the first to incorporate language information, resolving depth ambiguity in occluded and textureless regions. On NYU-Depth-v2 and KITTI, WorDepth reduces depth errors by about 5% relative to baselines, demonstrating effectiveness.
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.assessment: 该论文创新性地结合语言与视觉，为深度估计提供了新思路，但应用场景可能受限。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.contribution: 首次将语言先验用于单目深度估计，提升复杂场景下的深度预测精度。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.innovation: 设计变分语言模型，实现文本与视觉特征的深度交互。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.result: 在标准数据集上取得显著误差降低。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for._arxiv_id: WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for Monocular Depth Estimation.

MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.summary_cn: This paper addresses performance degradation of monocular 3D object detection under distribution shifts like weather changes. It proposes MonoTTA, a fully test-time adaptation method that adjusts model parameters using unsupervised losses. Compared to prior TTA methods, MonoTTA is tailored for monocular 3D detection, using geometric and depth consistency constraints. On datasets like KITTI-C, MonoTTA improves average precision by about 10% in foggy and rainy conditions, demonstrating robustness.
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.assessment: 该论文针对实际自动驾驶中的环境变化问题，提供了实用的测试时自适应方案，具有高应用价值。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.contribution: 提出首个针对单目3D检测的全测试时自适应框架。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.innovation: 利用几何一致性损失实现无监督自适应，保持3D结构完整性。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.result: 在多种天气条件下显著提升检测性能。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for._arxiv_id: MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

2407.16448|v2.summary_cn: This paper addresses performance degradation of monocular 3D detection in adverse weather like fog. It proposes MonoWAD, a weather-adaptive diffusion model with a weather codebook and adaptive enhancement. Compared to prior work, MonoWAD dynamically adjusts feature enhancement based on weather conditions. Experiments show MonoWAD improves 3D detection accuracy by about 15% in foggy scenes, demonstrating robustness.
2407.16448|v2.assessment: 该论文针对天气鲁棒性提出创新解决方案，对自动驾驶实际部署有重要意义。
2407.16448|v2.contribution: 提出天气自适应扩散模型，结合码本知识提升恶劣天气下的检测性能。
2407.16448|v2.innovation: 利用扩散模型和天气参考特征实现动态特征增强。
2407.16448|v2.result: 在多种天气条件下取得显著性能提升。

GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.summary_cn: This paper addresses scale ambiguity in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes GroCo, which uses ground plane constraints to recover metric scale. Compared to prior self-supervised methods, GroCo integrates ground geometry into training, solving scale drift without extra sensors. On KITTI and Cityscapes, GroCo reduces scale errors by about 8% in absolute relative error, demonstrating effectiveness.
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.assessment: 该论文通过简单有效的约束解决了自监督深度估计的关键问题，具有实用价值。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.contribution: 提出利用地面约束恢复度量尺度，提升自监督深度估计精度。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.innovation: 将地面平面先验融入自监督训练框架。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.result: 在多个数据集上显著降低尺度误差。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self._arxiv_id: GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self-supervised Monocular Depth.

2408.00361|v2.summary_cn: This paper addresses the performance gap between rich-resource and single-image self-supervised depth estimation. It proposes RPrDepth, which extracts reference features from rich-resource data offline and uses them during inference with only a single image. Compared to prior single-image methods, RPrDepth achieves accuracy comparable to rich-resource methods without extra inputs. Experiments on KITTI show RPrDepth outperforms other single-image models and matches multi-frame or high-resolution methods.
2408.00361|v2.assessment: 该论文巧妙利用离线先验提升单目推理性能，平衡了精度与实用性。
2408.00361|v2.contribution: 提出利用富资源先验提升单目深度估计精度，无需推理时额外输入。
2408.00361|v2.innovation: 设计离线特征提取和在线相似像素搜索机制。
2408.00361|v2.result: 在多个数据集上达到与富资源方法相当的性能。

Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对单目和双帧自监督深度估计中缺乏统一框架的问题，提出了Mono-ViFI，一个统一的学习框架。该方法通过联合训练单帧和双帧深度估计，利用视频帧间的几何一致性作为监督信号。相比已有工作，该框架能够同时处理静态和动态场景，提高了深度估计的准确性和鲁棒性。实验结果表明，该方法在多个基准数据集上取得了显著的性能提升。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified framework for self-supervised single and multi-frame monocular depth estimation by proposing Mono-ViFI. It jointly trains single-frame and multi-frame depth estimation using geometric consistency from video sequences as supervision. Compared to existing methods, this framework handles both static and dynamic scenes, improving accuracy and robustness. Experiments show significant performance gains on multiple benchmarks.
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.assessment: 该论文提出了一个统一的框架，有助于推动自监督深度估计的发展，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其创新性。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.contribution: 提出了一个统一的自监督单目和双帧深度估计学习框架。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.innovation: 联合训练单帧和双帧深度估计，利用视频几何一致性。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.result: 在多个基准数据集上取得显著性能提升。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework._arxiv_id: Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework for Self-supervised Single and Multi-frame Monocular Depth Estimation.

2403.11192|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对腹腔镜手术视频中烟雾去除困难、真实配对数据难以获取的问题，提出了自监督视频去烟方法SelfSVD。该方法利用高能设备激活前的清晰帧作为监督信号，并引入掩码策略和正则化项以避免平凡解。相比已有方法，该方法能够处理密集烟雾，并在真实手术场景中表现更好。实验表明，SelfSVD在构建的真实手术视频数据集上能更有效、高效地去除烟雾，并恢复更多细节。
2403.11192|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of smoke removal in laparoscopic surgery videos due to the difficulty of collecting real paired data by proposing SelfSVD, a self-supervised video desmoking method. It uses pre-smoke frames as supervision and introduces a masking strategy and regularization term to avoid trivial solutions. Compared to existing methods, it handles dense smoke better in real surgical scenarios. Experiments show it removes smoke more effectively and efficiently while recovering more details.
2403.11192|v2.assessment: 该论文针对特定医学应用场景，方法具有实用性，但与自动驾驶领域相关性较低。
2403.11192|v2.contribution: 提出了一个自监督手术视频去烟框架，并构建了真实数据集。
2403.11192|v2.innovation: 利用预烟雾帧作为自监督信号，结合掩码和正则化。
2403.11192|v2.result: 在真实手术视频数据集上有效去除烟雾并恢复细节。

Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对自监督单目深度估计在域泛化方面性能不佳的问题，提出了通过稳定对抗训练来提升域泛化能力的方法。该方法在训练过程中引入对抗性扰动，并采用稳定化策略以防止训练不稳定。相比已有工作，该方法增强了模型对未知域的适应能力。实验结果表明，该方法在多个跨域数据集上提高了深度估计的泛化性能。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor domain generalization of self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing stabilized adversarial training. It introduces adversarial perturbations during training with stabilization strategies to prevent instability. Compared to existing methods, it enhances adaptation to unseen domains. Experiments show improved generalization performance on multiple cross-domain datasets.
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.assessment: 该论文关注域泛化问题，对自动驾驶等实际应用有重要意义，但摘要信息不完整。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.contribution: 提出了一种稳定对抗训练方法以提升自监督深度估计的域泛化能力。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.innovation: 在自监督深度估计中引入稳定化的对抗训练。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.result: 在跨域数据集上提高了深度估计的泛化性能。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-._arxiv_id: Improving Domain Generalization in Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation via Stabilized Adversarial Training.

Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对伪激光雷达点云中类别不平衡问题，提出了一种数据增强方法。该方法通过增加额外成本（如100美元）来增强点云数据，以平衡不同类别的样本数量。相比已有方法，该方法旨在提高少数类别的检测性能。实验结果表明，该方法在解决类别不平衡问题上有效，但具体性能数据未在摘要中提供。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.summary_en: This paper addresses the class-imbalance problem in pseudo-LiDAR point clouds by proposing a data augmentation method. It enhances point cloud data with additional cost to balance sample counts across categories. Compared to existing methods, it aims to improve detection performance for minority classes. Experiments show effectiveness in resolving class imbalance, but specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.assessment: 该论文针对类别不平衡问题，但摘要信息有限，创新性和效果需进一步确认。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.contribution: 提出了一种针对伪激光雷达点云的类别不平衡数据增强方法。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.innovation: 通过额外成本增强点云数据以平衡类别。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.result: 有效解决类别不平衡问题，但具体数据未给出。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li._arxiv_id: Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-LiDAR Point Cloud for Resolving Class-imbalance Problem.

2406.12849|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对360度图像深度估计中缺乏标注数据的问题，提出了Depth Anywhere框架。该方法利用先进的透视深度估计模型作为教师，通过六面立方体投影生成伪标签，并采用离线掩码生成和在线半监督联合训练。相比已有360度方法，该方法有效利用未标注数据，显著提高了深度估计精度，尤其在零样本场景下。在Matterport3D和Stanford2D3D基准上取得了显著改进。
2406.12849|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of labeled data for 360-degree depth estimation by proposing Depth Anywhere. It uses perspective depth models as teachers to generate pseudo labels via six-face cube projection, with offline mask generation and online semi-supervised training. Compared to existing 360 methods, it effectively leverages unlabeled data, significantly improving accuracy, especially in zero-shot scenarios. It shows significant gains on Matterport3D and Stanford2D3D benchmarks.
2406.12849|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种实用的半监督框架，有效利用未标注360度数据，对VR和导航应用有重要价值。
2406.12849|v2.contribution: 提出了一个利用未标注360度数据增强深度估计的框架。
2406.12849|v2.innovation: 通过透视模型蒸馏和半监督训练提升360度深度估计。
2406.12849|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著提高深度估计精度，尤其在零样本场景。

2405.07696|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对单目3D检测中物体遮挡导致预测不准确的问题，提出了MonoMAE检测器。该方法受掩码自编码器启发，通过深度感知掩码和轻量级查询完成机制，在特征空间中模拟并重建遮挡物体。相比已有方法，该方法能学习更丰富的3D表示，提升遮挡和非遮挡物体的检测性能。实验表明，MonoMAE在定性和定量上均取得了优越的单目3D检测效果。
2405.07696|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of object occlusion degrading monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoMAE, inspired by Masked Autoencoders. It uses depth-aware masking and lightweight query completion to simulate and reconstruct occluded objects in feature space. Compared to existing methods, it learns richer 3D representations, improving detection for both occluded and non-occluded objects. Experiments show superior qualitative and quantitative performance.
2405.07696|v2.assessment: 该论文针对单目3D检测中的关键挑战，方法创新且实验充分，对自动驾驶感知有重要价值。
2405.07696|v2.contribution: 提出了一个基于掩码自编码器的单目3D检测器，解决遮挡问题。
2405.07696|v2.innovation: 引入深度感知掩码和查询完成机制模拟遮挡。
2405.07696|v2.result: 在遮挡和非遮挡场景下均取得优越的检测性能。

MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对单目3D检测中物体放置（3D位置估计）不准确的问题。②提出了MonoPlace3D方法，学习3D感知的物体放置，可能通过场景上下文或几何先验来优化物体在3D空间中的位置。③改进点在于直接建模物体放置，而非仅依赖2D到3D的回归，增强了空间一致性。④摘要不完整，未提供具体数据，但预期能提升单目3D检测的定位精度。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate 3D object placement in monocular 3D detection. It proposes MonoPlace3D to learn 3D-aware object placement, likely using scene context or geometric priors to refine positions. The improvement lies in directly modeling placement rather than pure regression, enhancing spatial consistency. Specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.assessment: 该论文针对单目3D检测的核心难点，方法思路有潜力，但摘要信息不足，需进一步验证。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.contribution: 提出一种3D感知物体放置方法，用于改进单目3D检测。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.innovation: 将物体放置建模为可学习过程，结合场景信息。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.result: 预期提升单目3D检测精度，但具体数据未给出。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl._arxiv_id: MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Placement for 3D Monocular Detection.

2509.00649|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对多视角3D人体姿态估计中泛化到新相机配置困难及遮挡场景下空间建模不足的问题。②提出了MV-SSM框架，使用状态空间建模（Mamba）在特征级和关键点级显式建模关节空间序列，并设计了投影状态空间（PSS）块和网格令牌引导的双向扫描（GTBS）。③改进点在于用状态空间模型替代注意力机制，更好地捕捉空间排列，减少对特定相机配置的过拟合。④实验表明MV-SSM在泛化性上优于现有最先进方法，但具体数值未完整给出。
2509.00649|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles poor generalization to new camera configurations and inadequate spatial modeling in multi-view 3D human pose estimation. It introduces MV-SSM, using state space modeling to explicitly model joint sequences at feature and keypoint levels, with a Projective State Space block and Grid Token-guided Bidirectional Scanning. This improves spatial arrangement modeling and reduces overfitting. Experiments show superior generalization over state-of-the-art methods.
2509.00649|v2.assessment: 该论文将状态空间模型引入多视角姿态估计，创新性强，但与应用领域相关性较低。
2509.00649|v2.contribution: 提出MV-SSM框架，用状态空间建模提升多视角3D姿态估计的泛化性。
2509.00649|v2.innovation: 将Mamba改造为GTBS扫描，用于投影空间建模。
2509.00649|v2.result: 在泛化性上超越现有最先进方法。

2503.14483|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对单目深度估计因模糊性导致精度不足，难以直接用于多视角重建的问题。②提出了将SfM信息作为强多视角先验融入单目深度估计过程，提升深度预测质量，并直接应用于多视角几何重建。③改进点在于利用SfM的几何约束弥补单目深度估计的歧义，增强跨视角一致性。④在公开真实世界数据集上，深度估计质量显著提升，在室内、街景和航拍场景的重建质量上超越了最先进的MVS方法。
2503.14483|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate monocular depth estimation limiting multi-view reconstruction. It incorporates SfM information as a strong multi-view prior into depth estimation, enhancing prediction quality for direct reconstruction. This improves cross-view consistency. Experiments show significant depth quality gains and reconstruction surpassing state-of-the-art MVS on real-world datasets.
2503.14483|v2.assessment: 该论文结合SfM与单目深度估计，方法实用且效果显著，对自动驾驶场景重建有重要价值。
2503.14483|v2.contribution: 提出SfM引导的单目深度估计方法，提升多视角重建质量。
2503.14483|v2.innovation: 将SfM先验集成到深度估计流程中。
2503.14483|v2.result: 深度估计和重建质量均超越现有方法。

2411.18613|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对从单目视频创建动态3D（4D）场景的挑战。②提出了CAT4D方法，利用多视角视频扩散模型，在指定相机姿态和时间戳下进行新视角合成，并结合采样方法将单目视频转换为多视角视频，通过优化可变形3D高斯表示实现4D重建。③改进点在于联合建模多视角和时间维度，支持任意视角和时间查询。④在新视角合成和动态场景重建基准上表现竞争力，并展示了从真实或生成视频进行4D场景生成的创造性能力。
2411.18613|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles creating dynamic 3D scenes from monocular video. CAT4D uses a multi-view video diffusion model for novel view synthesis at arbitrary poses and timestamps, converting monocular video to multi-view via sampling, then optimizing deformable 3D Gaussians. This jointly models spatial and temporal dimensions. Results show competitive performance on benchmarks and creative 4D generation.
2411.18613|v2.assessment: 该论文在4D生成领域具有创新性，方法先进，但与应用领域相关性一般。
2411.18613|v2.contribution: 提出CAT4D，实现从单目视频生成4D场景。
2411.18613|v2.innovation: 利用多视角视频扩散模型联合生成时空一致的视图。
2411.18613|v2.result: 在动态场景重建基准上表现优异。

GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对自监督单目深度估计中从点级到平面级建模的精度问题。②提出了GeoDepth方法，将深度建模从点级提升到平面级，可能通过平面假设或分段平滑约束来增强深度估计的几何一致性。③改进点在于利用平面结构先验，减少深度预测的噪声和误差。④摘要不完整，未提供具体数据，但预期能提升自监督深度估计的准确性。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_en: This paper addresses accuracy issues in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by shifting from point-level to plane-level modeling. GeoDepth likely uses planar assumptions or piecewise smoothness to improve geometric consistency. This reduces noise and errors. Specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.assessment: 该论文聚焦深度估计的建模粒度，思路合理，但摘要信息有限。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.contribution: 提出平面级深度建模方法，改进自监督单目深度估计。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.innovation: 从点级到平面级的建模转变。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.result: 预期提升深度估计精度，但数据未给出。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t._arxiv_id: GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-to-Depth Modeling for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

2412.06359|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对事件相机在资源受限机器人上在线自监督深度学习的计算效率问题。②提出了改进对比最大化的时间与内存效率，实现设备上低延迟单目深度估计的在线学习。③改进点在于优化计算流程，使实时学习成为可能，同时保持性能。④实验表明，在小型无人机上在线学习比仅预训练获得更准确的深度估计和更成功的避障行为，且深度估计性能在自监督方法中达到最先进水平。
2412.06359|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses computational inefficiency in online self-supervised learning for event-based depth estimation on resource-limited robots. It improves time and memory efficiency of contrast maximization, enabling on-device learning. This allows real-time adaptation. Experiments show online learning on a drone yields better depth accuracy and obstacle avoidance than pre-training alone, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
2412.06359|v2.assessment: 该论文解决在线学习的实际部署问题，对机器人应用有重要价值，方法高效且效果显著。
2412.06359|v2.contribution: 实现事件相机深度估计的在线设备端学习。
2412.06359|v2.innovation: 优化对比最大化流程以支持实时学习。
2412.06359|v2.result: 在线学习提升深度精度和避障成功率。

2412.03079|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目视频深度估计中跨帧不一致的问题，现有方法依赖视频扩散模型，训练成本高且只能产生尺度不变的深度，缺乏相机位姿。②提出了Align3R方法，利用DUSt3R模型对齐不同时间步的估计单目深度图，通过微调DUSt3R并优化重建深度图和相机位姿。③相比已有工作，该方法无需视频扩散模型，能同时估计一致的视频深度和相机位姿。④实验表明，Align3R在动态视频上估计的深度和位姿优于基线方法。
2412.03079|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistency of monocular video depth estimation by proposing Align3R, which fine-tunes DUSt3R with estimated depth inputs and optimizes depth maps and camera poses. It avoids expensive video diffusion models and achieves superior performance in estimating consistent depth and poses for dynamic videos.
2412.03079|v2.assessment: 该方法为动态视频深度估计提供了新思路，利用几何对齐替代生成模型，具有实用价值。
2412.03079|v2.contribution: 提出Align3R，利用DUSt3R对齐单目深度，实现动态视频的一致深度和位姿估计。
2412.03079|v2.innovation: 将DUSt3R用于视频深度对齐，并联合优化深度和位姿。
2412.03079|v2.result: 在动态视频上优于基线方法。

2411.11361|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计的可扩展性问题，现有方法如Depth Anything在精度上仍有提升空间。②提出了深度自回归模型DAR，采用两种自回归目标：低到高分辨率的分块因果掩码和递归离散化深度范围的序数回归。③相比已有工作，DAR首次将自回归范式应用于单目深度估计，并实现了模型规模的可扩展性。④在KITTI上，DAR以2.0B模型达到RMSE 1.799，比当前SOTA（Depth Anything的1.896）提升5%，并在NYU Depth v2上刷新SOTA，同时展现零样本泛化能力。
2411.11361|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces DAR, an autoregressive monocular depth estimator with two objectives: low-to-high resolution token prediction and coarse-to-fine ordinal regression. Scaling to 2.0B parameters, DAR achieves RMSE 1.799 on KITTI, a 5% improvement over Depth Anything, and sets new SOTA on NYU Depth v2 with zero-shot generalization.
2411.11361|v2.assessment: 自回归范式在深度估计中展现出强大潜力，可扩展性显著，值得关注。
2411.11361|v2.contribution: 提出DAR，首个可扩展的自回归单目深度估计模型。
2411.11361|v2.innovation: 结合分辨率自回归和序数回归，实现高效深度预测。

2503.16535|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目深度估计中忽略相机内在信息的问题，现有模型仅依赖图像间关系。②提出了具身深度估计方法，将相机模型和物理特性融入深度学习，结合RGB特征和文本描述进行实时深度计算。③相比已有工作，该方法利用相机内参和语言先验，增强了几何和视觉理解。④实验表明，模型能实时计算具身场景深度，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2503.16535|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes an embodied depth estimation method that integrates camera intrinsic properties and text descriptions with RGB features for monocular depth estimation. It enables real-time depth computation without extra equipment, but lacks quantitative results in the abstract.
2503.16535|v2.assessment: 想法新颖，结合相机模型和语言先验，但实验证据不足。
2503.16535|v2.contribution: 提出具身深度估计，融合相机内参和语言信息。
2503.16535|v2.innovation: 将相机物理特性嵌入网络，并利用多模态互补。
2503.16535|v2.result: 实现实时深度估计，但未报告具体性能。

Mono3DVLT: Monocular-Video-Based 3D Visu.summary_cn: ①论文标题涉及单目视频3D视觉语言跟踪，但摘要为空，无法评估具体问题和方法。②由于缺乏摘要，无法判断其贡献和创新。③无法比较与已有工作的改进。④无法提供效果数据。

2508.20488|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测在测试时域偏移下性能下降的问题，现有TTA方法未处理语义和几何双重不确定性。②提出了DUO框架，通过凸优化视角推导focal loss的凸结构，并设计无监督版本实现标签无关的不确定性加权，同时引入语义感知法向场约束保持几何一致性。③相比已有工作，DUO首次联合最小化语义和几何不确定性。④实验表明，DUO在多种域偏移下显著提升M3OD的鲁棒性（摘要未提供具体数值）。
2508.20488|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DUO, the first TTA framework for monocular 3D detection that jointly minimizes semantic and geometric uncertainties via convex focal loss and semantic-aware normal constraints. It enhances robustness under domain shifts, though specific metrics are not given.
2508.20488|v2.assessment: 针对M3OD的TTA问题提出了系统性解决方案，具有实际应用价值。
2508.20488|v2.contribution: 提出DUO，首个联合优化双重不确定性的TTA框架。
2508.20488|v2.innovation: 利用凸优化设计无监督损失，并引入几何约束。
2508.20488|v2.result: 在域偏移下提升鲁棒性。

2507.23567|v2.summary_cn: ①针对单目3D检测局限于封闭集设置的问题，无法处理新场景和新类别。②提出了3D-MOOD，首个端到端单目开放集3D检测器，通过3D边界框头将2D开放集检测提升到3D空间，并利用几何先验和规范图像空间增强跨数据集泛化。③相比已有工作，3D-MOOD实现了2D和3D任务的联合训练。④在Omni3D封闭集和开放集（Omni3D到Argoverse 2、ScanNet）上达到新SOTA。
2507.23567|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces 3D-MOOD, the first end-to-end monocular open-set 3D detector, lifting 2D detections to 3D with a dedicated head and geometry priors. It achieves SOTA on Omni3D and open-set benchmarks like Argoverse 2 and ScanNet.
2507.23567|v2.assessment: 开创了单目开放集3D检测方向，具有重要研究意义。
2507.23567|v2.contribution: 提出3D-MOOD，首个单目开放集3D检测器。
2507.23567|v2.innovation: 将2D开放集检测扩展到3D，并设计规范图像空间。

2510.09320|v2.summary_cn: ① 针对自监督单目深度估计中语义-空间知识提取不足导致性能受限的问题。② 提出Hybrid-depth框架，系统整合CLIP和DINO基础模型，通过粗到细的渐进学习：先聚合CLIP全局语义和DINO局部空间细节，在对比语言引导下设计近远图像块代理任务实现深度感知对齐；再结合相机位姿和像素级语言对齐细化深度预测。③ 改进点在于利用语言引导解决特征粒度不匹配，且作为即插即用模块可无缝集成到现有MDE管线。④ 实验表明该方法有效提升连续深度估计精度，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2510.09320|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient semantic-spatial knowledge extraction in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing Hybrid-depth, a framework integrating CLIP and DINO with coarse-to-fine language-guided feature aggregation. It introduces a proxy task for depth-aware alignment and a plug-and-play encoder compatible with existing pipelines, improving depth accuracy without specific metrics reported.
2510.09320|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地融合基础模型和语言引导，为自监督深度估计提供新思路，但缺乏定量结果，需进一步验证。
2510.09320|v2.contribution: 提出一种结合CLIP和DINO的语言引导粗到细特征聚合框架，提升自监督单目深度估计性能。
2510.09320|v2.innovation: 利用对比语言引导和代理任务实现跨粒度特征对齐，解决语义-空间信息融合问题。
2510.09320|v2.result: 有效增强深度估计精度，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。

2502.14573|v2.summary_cn: ① 针对自监督单目深度估计在反射表面因违反朗伯体假设导致训练不准确的问题。② 提出利用三元组挖掘定位像素级反射区域，结合相机几何设计反射感知三元组损失，惩罚反射区域的光度误差最小化，同时保持非反射区域精度；并引入反射感知知识蒸馏，使学生模型选择性学习不同区域知识。③ 改进点在于专门处理反射表面这一难点，且不牺牲整体精度。④ 多数据集评估表明该方法有效提升反射区域深度估计鲁棒性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
2502.14573|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles inaccurate depth estimation on reflective surfaces in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing a triplet mining strategy to localize reflective regions and a reflection-aware loss that penalizes photometric errors there. It also incorporates reflection-aware knowledge distillation for selective learning, enhancing robustness across datasets without specific metrics.
2502.14573|v2.assessment: 针对反射表面这一实际挑战提出系统解决方案，方法新颖且实用，但需更多实验细节支撑。
2502.14573|v2.contribution: 提出反射感知的三元组损失和知识蒸馏策略，提升自监督深度估计在反射区域的鲁棒性。
2502.14573|v2.innovation: 利用三元组挖掘和相机几何精确识别反射区域，并设计针对性损失函数。
2502.14573|v2.result: 在多个数据集上有效增强反射表面深度估计精度。

Distil-E2D: Distilling Image-to-Depth Pr.summary_cn: ① 针对事件相机单目深度估计中缺乏标注数据的问题。② 提出Distil-E2D方法，通过知识蒸馏将图像到深度先验迁移到事件数据，利用事件流的时间特性辅助深度预测。③ 改进点在于利用图像域预训练模型的知识，减少对事件标注的依赖。④ 摘要不完整，未提供具体效果数据。
Distil-E2D: Distilling Image-to-Depth Pr.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of labeled data in event-based monocular depth estimation by proposing Distil-E2D, which distills image-to-depth priors to event data. It leverages temporal event characteristics, but the abstract is incomplete with no results reported.
Distil-E2D: Distilling Image-to-Depth Pr.assessment: 方向有潜力，但摘要信息不足，难以全面评估其贡献和效果。
Distil-E2D: Distilling Image-to-Depth Pr.contribution: 提出一种知识蒸馏方法，将图像深度先验迁移至事件相机深度估计。
Distil-E2D: Distilling Image-to-Depth Pr.innovation: 利用图像域知识减少事件数据标注需求。

ST$2$360D: Spatial-to-Temporal Consisten.summary_cn: ① 针对360度单目深度估计中时空一致性问题。② 提出ST2 360D方法，利用空间到时间一致性进行无训练深度估计，可能通过跨视角信息融合提升精度。③ 改进点在于无需训练即可适应360度场景。④ 摘要不完整，未提供具体效果。
ST$2$360D: Spatial-to-Temporal Consisten.summary_en: This paper addresses spatial-to-temporal consistency in 360-degree monocular depth estimation by proposing ST2 360D, a training-free method that leverages cross-view information. The abstract is incomplete with no quantitative results.
ST$2$360D: Spatial-to-Temporal Consisten.assessment: 无训练方法具有应用价值，但摘要缺失关键细节，需进一步查阅全文。
ST$2$360D: Spatial-to-Temporal Consisten.contribution: 提出一种无训练的360度深度估计时空一致性方法。
ST$2$360D: Spatial-to-Temporal Consisten.innovation: 利用空间到时间一致性实现无需训练的自适应。
ST$2$360D: Spatial-to-Temporal Consisten._arxiv_id: ST$2$360D: Spatial-to-Temporal Consistency for Training-free 360 Monocular Depth Estimation.

2507.00981|v2.summary_cn: ① 针对单目深度估计标准基准仅评估精度而忽视鲁棒性的问题。② 提出PDE基准，利用程序化生成3D场景，系统评估模型对物体、相机、材质和光照等受控扰动的鲁棒性。③ 改进点在于提供首个系统化鲁棒性评估工具，弥补现有基准不足。④ 分析揭示了最先进深度模型面临的挑战性扰动，为后续研究提供指导，代码和数据已公开。
2507.00981|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of robustness evaluation in monocular depth estimation benchmarks by introducing PDE, a procedural generation-based benchmark that tests models under controlled perturbations like object, camera, material, and lighting changes. It reveals challenging perturbations for state-of-the-art models, providing insights for future research with public code and data.
2507.00981|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了鲁棒性评估空白，对模型实际部署有重要参考价值，值得关注。
2507.00981|v2.contribution: 提出程序化深度评估基准PDE，系统评估单目深度模型的鲁棒性。
2507.00981|v2.innovation: 利用程序化生成实现可控扰动测试，覆盖多维度变化。
2507.00981|v2.result: 识别出最先进模型的鲁棒性弱点，并公开资源。

QSCA: Quantization with Self-Compensatin.summary_cn: ① 针对单目深度估计模型量化中精度下降的问题。② 提出QSCA方法，通过自补偿辅助机制减少量化误差，可能结合辅助损失或参数调整。③ 改进点在于提升量化后模型的性能保持能力。④ 摘要不完整，未提供具体效果数据。
QSCA: Quantization with Self-Compensatin.summary_en: This paper addresses accuracy degradation in quantized monocular depth estimation models by proposing QSCA, a self-compensating auxiliary mechanism to reduce quantization errors. The abstract is incomplete with no quantitative results.
QSCA: Quantization with Self-Compensatin.assessment: 量化是模型部署的关键技术，但摘要信息有限，需更多细节评估。
QSCA: Quantization with Self-Compensatin.contribution: 提出自补偿辅助量化方法，提升单目深度估计模型的量化性能。
QSCA: Quantization with Self-Compensatin.innovation: 通过自补偿机制减少量化误差。

2512.08358|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对单目3D跟踪中相机运动与前景动态运动分离不彻底、以及无法密集跟踪新出现动态目标的问题。②提出了TrackingWorld，一种在world-centric 3D坐标系下对几乎所有像素进行密集3D跟踪的新流程，包括跟踪上采样器将稀疏2D轨迹提升为密集2D轨迹，并通过冗余消除处理新出现目标，最后用优化框架将密集2D轨迹反投影为3D轨迹。③相比已有工作，改进在于能分离相机运动并处理动态新目标，实现密集跟踪。④在合成和真实数据集上的广泛评估表明，该系统实现了准确且密集的3D跟踪。
2512.08358|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of monocular 3D tracking in separating camera motion from foreground dynamics and densely tracking newly emerging objects. It proposes TrackingWorld, a pipeline that upsamples sparse 2D tracks to dense ones, reduces redundancy, and optimizes camera poses and 3D coordinates to produce world-centric 3D trajectories. Extensive evaluations on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate accurate and dense 3D tracking.
2512.08358|v2.assessment: 该工作推动了单目3D跟踪向密集化和世界坐标系方向发展，对自动驾驶动态场景理解有重要参考价值。
2512.08358|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于优化和上采样的密集单目3D跟踪框架，支持新出现目标的跟踪。
2512.08358|v2.innovation: 引入跟踪上采样器和冗余消除机制，结合相机位姿估计实现像素级3D轨迹重建。
2512.08358|v2.result: 在多个数据集上实现了准确且密集的3D跟踪效果。

2503.22976|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对视觉语言模型在3D空间感知和推理能力不足的问题。②提出了一个基于3D ground-truth场景数据的2D空间数据生成和标注流程，构建了大规模数据集SPAR-7M和评估基准SPAR-Bench，支持单视图和多视图输入，并训练模型提升空间理解。③相比已有方法，不直接引入3D表示，而是利用空间相关的图像数据来解锁VLM的潜力。④在2D空间基准上达到最先进性能，并在3D任务微调后表现竞争力。
2503.22976|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited spatial perception of vision-language models in 3D scenes. It introduces a novel 2D spatial data generation pipeline using 3D ground-truth, creating the SPAR-7M dataset and SPAR-Bench benchmark for comprehensive evaluation. Training on these datasets achieves state-of-the-art performance on 2D spatial benchmarks and competitive results after 3D fine-tuning.
2503.22976|v2.assessment: 该工作通过数据生成策略有效提升VLM的空间推理能力，为多模态3D理解提供了新思路。
2503.22976|v2.contribution: 构建了大规模空间任务数据集和基准，并展示了训练方法对VLM空间能力的提升。
2503.22976|v2.innovation: 利用3D标注生成多样化2D空间任务，避免直接修改模型架构。
2503.22976|v2.result: 在2D空间基准上取得最先进性能，3D任务上表现竞争力。

2503.15905|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对自监督单目深度估计中预测模糊和伪影问题，以及扩散模型先验难以直接应用的问题。②提出了Jasmine，首个基于Stable Diffusion的自监督单目深度估计框架，通过混合图像重建的代理任务保留SD细节先验，并设计Scale-Shift GRU来弥合SD输出与自监督深度估计之间的分布差异。③相比已有SD-based方法（均为监督），本方法无需高精度监督即可利用扩散先验。④实验表明，该方法增强了预测的锐利度和泛化能力。
2503.15905|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses blur and artifacts in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing Jasmine, the first SD-based self-supervised framework. It uses a hybrid image reconstruction surrogate task to preserve SD priors and a Scale-Shift GRU to align distributions. The method enhances sharpness and generalization without additional supervision.
2503.15905|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将扩散先验引入自监督深度估计，解决了监督依赖问题，对无监督3D感知有启发。
2503.15905|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于Stable Diffusion的自监督深度估计框架，并设计了有效的代理任务和分布对齐模块。
2503.15905|v2.innovation: 利用混合图像重建和Scale-Shift GRU克服扩散模型与自监督任务的尺度不匹配。
2503.15905|v2.result: 提升了深度预测的锐利度和泛化性能。

2601.07298|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在多图像推理任务中性能显著下降的问题，该任务涉及图像间的复杂关系和跨图像分散的关键信息。②提出了一个认知启发的元动作框架（CINEMA），将多图像推理分解为五个结构化元动作：全局、聚焦、提示、思考和回答，显式模拟人类认知步骤；并引入基于检索的树采样策略生成冷启动训练数据，以及两阶段强化学习范式（多样性保持探索和DAPO退火利用）。③相比已有工作，创新在于将人类认知过程显式建模为可学习的动作序列，并通过冷启动和强化学习结合提升推理能力。④构建了包含56k冷启动和58k强化学习实例的数据集，覆盖多图像、多帧和单图像任务，但摘要未提供具体性能数据。
2601.07298|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the degraded performance of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in multi-image reasoning tasks, which involve complex inter-image relationships and scattered information. It proposes a Cognition-Inspired Meta-Action Framework (CINEMA) that decomposes reasoning into five meta-actions, uses retrieval-based tree sampling for cold-start training, and adopts a two-stage reinforcement learning paradigm. The method improves reasoning by explicitly modeling cognitive steps, though specific quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2601.07298|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦多图像推理这一重要但研究不足的方向，框架设计有认知科学依据，但摘要缺乏实验数据，且与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
2601.07298|v2.contribution: 提出了CINEMA框架，将多图像推理分解为元动作序列并融合冷启动与强化学习训练。
2601.07298|v2.innovation: 以人类认知过程为灵感，设计结构化元动作和两阶段强化学习策略。
2601.07298|v2.result: 构建了大规模训练数据集，但未在摘要中给出具体性能提升数据。

1911.07883|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对视觉语言导航（VLN）任务中，现有方法忽略了环境中丰富的语义信息（如隐式导航图或子轨迹语义）的问题。②提出了Auxiliary Reasoning Navigation (AuxRN)框架，包含四个自监督辅助推理任务：解释先前动作、估计导航进度、预测下一朝向和评估轨迹一致性。③相比已有工作，该框架利用额外训练信号帮助智能体获取语义表示，以推理自身活动并建立对环境全面感知。④实验表明辅助推理任务提升了导航性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
1911.07883|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that existing Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) methods neglect rich semantic information in the environment. It proposes Auxiliary Reasoning Navigation (AuxRN), a framework with four self-supervised auxiliary reasoning tasks to leverage additional training signals. Experiments show that these tasks improve navigation performance, though specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
1911.07883|v2.assessment: 该论文将自监督辅助任务引入VLN，思路新颖，但领域相关性较低，且摘要缺乏定量结果，影响力有限。
1911.07883|v2.contribution: 提出AuxRN框架，通过四个自监督辅助推理任务增强VLN中的语义感知与推理能力。
1911.07883|v2.innovation: 利用自监督辅助任务挖掘环境语义信息，提升导航推理能力。
1911.07883|v2.result: 实验表明辅助推理任务提升了导航性能，但未给出具体数据。

2004.04917|v2.summary_cn: ①针对社交媒体危机事件检测中，现有方法多采用图像或文本单一模态，限制检测性能和信息质量的问题。②提出一种新的多模态融合方法，利用图像和文本作为输入，引入跨注意力模块过滤弱模态中的无信息或误导性成分，并采用基于图的方法在训练中随机转换多模态对嵌入以正则化学习。③相比已有工作，该方法能逐样本处理模态噪声，并通过图方法增强鲁棒性。④实验效果未在摘要中提供具体数据。
2004.04917|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem of unimodal event detection in social media crisis scenarios. It proposes a multimodal fusion method with a cross-attention module to filter uninformative components and a graph-based approach for stochastic embedding transitions during training. The method improves robustness but specific performance metrics are not reported in the abstract.
2004.04917|v2.assessment: 该论文针对危机事件检测提出多模态融合方案，方法设计合理，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性低。
2004.04917|v2.contribution: 提出结合跨注意力与图正则化的多模态融合方法，用于社交媒体危机事件分类。
2004.04917|v2.innovation: 引入跨注意力模块逐样本过滤弱模态噪声，并用图方法增强训练正则化。
2004.04917|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。

Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶在未知恶劣天气（如雾天）下感知性能下降的问题，现有传感器融合方法在训练与测试天气条件不一致时失效。②提出一种深度多模态传感器融合方法，通过特定设计使模型在未见过的恶劣天气中保持鲁棒性，但摘要内容不完整，未详细说明具体方法。③相比已有工作，该方法关注跨天气泛化能力。④效果未在摘要中提供具体数据。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.summary_en: This paper addresses the degradation of autonomous driving perception in unseen adverse weather conditions. It proposes a deep multimodal sensor fusion approach designed for robustness across weather conditions, though the abstract is incomplete and lacks method details and quantitative results.
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.assessment: 该论文直接针对自动驾驶恶劣天气感知问题，相关性高，但摘要不完整，需查阅全文评估质量。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.contribution: 提出面向未知恶劣天气的深度多模态传感器融合方法，提升自动驾驶感知鲁棒性。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.innovation: 关注跨天气泛化的多模态融合设计。

1911.06258|v2.summary_cn: ①针对TextVQA任务中，现有方法多采用成对模态融合机制且将问题视为单步分类，限制了推理能力。②提出基于多模态Transformer架构的模型，将文本、图像和问题嵌入到共同语义空间，通过自注意力建模模态间与模态内上下文，并采用动态指针网络实现迭代答案解码。③相比已有工作，该方法实现了同质化多模态融合和多步预测。④在三个基准数据集上优于现有方法，但摘要未提供具体数值。
1911.06258|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations of pairwise fusion and single-step classification in TextVQA. It proposes a multimodal transformer with dynamic pointer networks for iterative answer decoding, embedding modalities into a common space. The model outperforms existing approaches on three benchmarks, though specific numbers are not given.
1911.06258|v2.assessment: 该论文在多模态推理上有一定创新，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
1911.06258|v2.contribution: 提出基于多模态Transformer和动态指针网络的TextVQA模型，支持迭代答案预测。
1911.06258|v2.innovation: 将多模态融合统一到共同语义空间，并用指针网络实现多步解码。
1911.06258|v2.result: 在三个TextVQA基准上优于现有方法。

1911.08670|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态CNN融合中，晚期融合简单但忽略模态间交互，而中间融合方法复杂且难以适配不同空间维度的问题。②提出多模态迁移模块（MMTM），利用squeeze and excitation操作，在特征层级不同位置进行慢速模态融合，重新校准各CNN流的通道特征。③相比其他中间融合方法，MMTM可处理不同空间维度的卷积层，且对网络架构改动小，可复用预训练权重。④实验表明该方法提升了多个知名网络的识别准确率，但摘要未提供具体数据。
1911.08670|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations of late fusion and complexity of intermediate fusion in multimodal CNNs. It proposes the Multimodal Transfer Module (MMTM), using squeeze-and-excitation operations for slow fusion at various feature levels. The module is flexible across spatial dimensions and minimally invasive, improving recognition accuracy on well-known networks.
1911.08670|v2.assessment: 该论文提出轻量级多模态融合模块，具有一定通用性，但相关性一般，创新性有限。
1911.08670|v2.contribution: 提出MMTM模块，实现多模态CNN中的通道级特征重校准与慢速融合。
1911.08670|v2.innovation: 利用squeeze-and-excitation实现跨模态通道重校准，支持不同空间维度。
1911.08670|v2.result: 提升了多个CNN的识别准确率。

2006.04700|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对自动驾驶场景中，从单目RGB相机视角预测其他车辆和行人未来位置及新物体出现的问题，面临部分遮挡和自车运动导致的视角变化以及未来状态分布多模态的挑战。方法上，不依赖地图结构知识，而是从当前图像的语义图估计特定类别物体的可达性先验，并结合自车运动规划将其传播到未来，同时采用多假设学习来捕捉多模态分布。相比以往工作，该方法的改进在于无需地图先验，利用可达性先验和多假设学习提升了跟踪物体未来位置预测的准确性，并首次实现了新物体出现的预测。实验表明，该方法在多模态预测上优于基线，并展示了在未见数据集上的零样本迁移能力。
2006.04700|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses predicting future locations of vehicles and pedestrians and emergence of new objects from an egocentric monocular RGB camera in autonomous driving, tackling partial visibility and multimodal future distributions. The method estimates a reachability prior from the semantic map of the current image and propagates it into the future using planned egomotion, combined with multi-hypotheses learning. It improves multimodal prediction of tracked object locations and enables emergence prediction, demonstrating promising zero-shot transfer to unseen datasets.
2006.04700|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶预测中的实际难题，提出无需地图的可达性先验方法，具有创新性和实用性，值得关注。
2006.04700|v2.contribution: 提出结合可达性先验和多假设学习的方法，用于单目视角下物体未来位置和新物体出现的多模态预测。
2006.04700|v2.innovation: 利用语义图估计可达性先验并传播到未来，无需地图结构知识，同时支持新物体出现预测。
2006.04700|v2.result: 实验显示在多模态预测上优于基线，并展示了零样本迁移能力。

2003.06692|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对视频和图像中感知人类情绪识别的问题，提出EmotiCon算法，基于心理学中的弗雷格上下文原则，结合三种上下文解释：多模态（如人脸和步态）、语义上下文（通过自注意力CNN编码）以及深度图建模的社会动态交互和邻近关系。相比已有方法，该方法的改进在于全面整合多种上下文信息，在EMOTIC基准上平均精度达到35.48，比之前方法提升7-8个百分点，并引入新数据集GroupWalk，其平均精度为65.83。
2003.06692|v2.summary_en: This paper presents EmotiCon, a context-aware algorithm for perceived emotion recognition from videos and images, integrating three interpretations of context based on Frege's principle: multimodal cues, semantic context via self-attention CNN, and socio-dynamic interactions from depth maps. It achieves an AP of 35.48 on EMOTIC, improving 7-8 over prior methods, and introduces GroupWalk dataset with AP of 65.83.
2003.06692|v2.assessment: 该论文在情绪识别领域整合多种上下文信息，方法有创新性，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
2003.06692|v2.contribution: 提出EmotiCon算法，结合多模态、语义和深度上下文进行情绪识别。
2003.06692|v2.innovation: 基于弗雷格原则，系统性地融合三种上下文解释。
2003.06692|v2.result: 在EMOTIC和GroupWalk数据集上均优于先前方法。

2001.09691|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对细粒度动作识别中环境偏差导致的域偏移问题，提出利用多模态视频数据（RGB和光流）进行无监督域适应。方法上，除了对抗性对齐外，还利用模态间的对应关系作为自监督对齐信号。相比仅使用对抗训练的方法，该方法的改进在于结合多模态自监督，在EPIC-Kitchens数据集上，仅用多模态自监督比源域训练平均提升2.4%，结合对抗训练后比其他UDA方法提升3%。
2001.09691|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses domain shift in fine-grained action recognition due to environmental bias, proposing a UDA approach that exploits multi-modal correspondence (RGB and optical flow) as self-supervised alignment in addition to adversarial training. It improves over source-only training by 2.4% with self-supervision alone and outperforms other UDA methods by 3% on EPIC-Kitchens.
2001.09691|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦动作识别中的域适应，方法有一定价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心领域关联较弱。
2001.09691|v2.contribution: 提出结合多模态自监督和对抗训练的无监督域适应方法。
2001.09691|v2.innovation: 利用模态间对应关系作为自监督信号。

2003.13594|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文探讨从电影对话中预测人类动作的可能性，训练基于BERT的Speech2Action分类器，从剧本中学习对话与动作的关联，并应用于大规模未标注电影语料，获得弱标签用于训练视频动作识别模型。相比需要人工标注的方法，该方法的改进在于无需任何手动标注动作示例，在标准动作识别基准上展示了优越性能。
2003.13594|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates predicting human actions from dialogue, training a BERT-based Speech2Action classifier on screenplays and applying it to a large unlabelled movie corpus to obtain weak labels for video clips. It achieves superior action recognition performance without using any manually labelled action examples.
2003.13594|v2.assessment: 该论文提出跨模态监督的创意方法，但主题与自动驾驶感知领域不直接相关。
2003.13594|v2.contribution: 提出利用对话预测动作标签的跨模态监督方法。
2003.13594|v2.innovation: 从剧本学习对话-动作关联，无需人工标注。
2003.13594|v2.result: 在标准基准上优于无标注训练方法。

2004.00280|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对跨模态哈希检索中监督方法需要大量标注的问题，提出一种无监督知识蒸馏方法，利用教师-学生优化，将无监督方法产生的输出作为监督信号来指导监督方法。相比现有无监督方法，该方法的改进在于结合了监督方法的准确性，在MIRFlickr和NUS-WIDE数据集上大幅优于所有现有无监督方法。
2004.00280|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the annotation burden in supervised cross-modal hashing by proposing an unsupervised knowledge distillation approach, using teacher-student optimization to propagate knowledge from unsupervised outputs to guide supervised methods. It outperforms all existing unsupervised methods by a large margin on MIRFlickr and NUS-WIDE.
2004.00280|v2.assessment: 该论文在跨模态检索领域有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性低。
2004.00280|v2.contribution: 提出无监督知识蒸馏方法用于跨模态哈希。
2004.00280|v2.innovation: 利用教师-学生优化传播知识。
2004.00280|v2.result: 在基准数据集上大幅优于无监督方法。

Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对设备故障检测中的异常检测问题，提出了一种可解释的多维多模态异常检测方法，并采用负采样策略来增强模型对异常模式的识别能力。该方法通过融合多种模态数据并利用负样本进行训练，旨在提高异常检测的准确性和可解释性。与现有工作相比，其改进点在于引入了负采样机制以更好地处理数据不平衡问题，并提供了多维度的解释性分析。实验结果表明该方法在设备故障检测任务上取得了优于基线方法的性能，但摘要中未提供具体数据。
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.summary_en: This paper addresses anomaly detection for device failure by proposing an interpretable, multidimensional, multimodal method with negative sampling. It fuses multiple data modalities and uses negative samples to improve detection accuracy and interpretability, outperforming baselines in experiments, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低，主要面向工业设备故障检测，但多模态异常检测和负采样策略对开放集检测有一定启发，整体重要性一般。
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.contribution: 提出了一种结合负采样和可解释性分析的多模态异常检测框架。
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.innovation: 在异常检测中引入负采样策略以增强对罕见故障模式的识别。
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.result: 在设备故障检测任务上取得了优于基线方法的性能。
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo._arxiv_id: Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimodal Anomaly Detection with Negative Sampling for Detection of Device Failure.

WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.summary_cn: ①这篇论文介绍了一个多模态多跳问答挑战赛WebQA，旨在推动视觉与语言理解研究。②提出了一个包含图像和文本的问答数据集，要求模型进行多步推理。③相比已有工作，该挑战强调多模态信息的联合推理和跨模态跳转。④摘要未提供具体数据，但作为挑战赛，其价值在于提供基准和推动社区研究。
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.summary_en: This paper introduces WebQA, a multimodal multihop question answering challenge. It presents a dataset requiring joint reasoning over images and text. The work aims to advance research in multimodal reasoning by providing a new benchmark.
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.assessment: 作为挑战赛介绍，对多模态推理领域有一定参考价值，但缺乏具体方法和技术细节。
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.contribution: 提出了一个多模态多跳问答挑战赛及数据集。
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.innovation: 强调多模态跨跳推理的挑战设计。
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.result: 提供了新的基准，但未报告具体性能数据。
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha._arxiv_id: WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Challenge.

Multimodal single cell data integration.summary_cn: ①这篇论文总结了单细胞数据整合挑战赛的结果和经验。②涉及多模态生物数据整合方法。③相比已有工作，该挑战聚焦于生物信息学领域。④摘要未提供具体数据，且与自动驾驶视觉研究无关。
Multimodal single cell data integration.summary_en: This paper summarizes results from a multimodal single-cell data integration challenge. It focuses on bioinformatics methods for integrating heterogeneous biological data. The relevance to computer vision is minimal.
Multimodal single cell data integration.assessment: 与用户研究领域完全无关，属于生物信息学范畴。
Multimodal single cell data integration.contribution: 总结了单细胞数据整合挑战的经验。
Multimodal single cell data integration._arxiv_id: Multimodal single cell data integration challenge: Results and lessons learned.

There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对多目标检测与跟踪中依赖视觉信息的问题，提出利用声音作为辅助信号。②通过知识蒸馏，将多模态（视觉+声音）知识从教师网络转移到仅使用视觉的学生网络，实现自监督学习。③相比已有工作，创新性地引入音频模态来增强视觉模型的鲁棒性，无需额外标注。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在自监督多目标检测与跟踪任务上展示了潜力。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-object detection and tracking by leveraging sound as auxiliary signal. It distills multimodal knowledge from a teacher to a vision-only student network for self-supervised learning. The approach enhances robustness without extra annotations, showing promise in the task.
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.assessment: 方法新颖，将音频与视觉结合用于自监督学习，对多模态感知有启发意义。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.contribution: 提出利用声音知识蒸馏提升视觉多目标检测与跟踪。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.innovation: 引入音频模态进行自监督知识蒸馏。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.result: 未报告具体数值，但展示了方法可行性。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S._arxiv_id: There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Detection and Tracking With Sound by Distilling Multimodal Knowledge.

Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对雾天环境下车辆检测性能下降的问题，提出融合激光雷达和雷达信号的多模态检测方法。②设计了一种互补融合策略，利用激光雷达的高精度和雷达的穿透性来增强雾天检测鲁棒性。③相比已有单模态或简单融合方法，该方法在恶劣天气下更具适应性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但针对自动驾驶感知中的实际挑战，具有工程价值。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.summary_en: This paper tackles degraded vehicle detection in foggy weather by fusing LiDAR and radar signals. It proposes a complementary fusion strategy leveraging LiDAR's precision and radar's penetration. The method enhances robustness in adverse conditions, addressing a key challenge in autonomous driving.
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.assessment: 针对自动驾驶恶劣天气感知的实用研究，融合策略有实际应用价值。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.contribution: 提出雾天环境下LiDAR与雷达互补融合的车辆检测方法。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.innovation: 利用雷达穿透性弥补LiDAR在雾天的不足。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.result: 未报告具体数值，但方法针对性强。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F._arxiv_id: Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in Foggy Weather Using Complementary Lidar and Radar Signals.

UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对跨语言跨模态视觉-语言预训练问题，提出UC2模型。②通过设计通用预训练任务，支持多语言和视觉输入的统一建模。③相比已有工作，扩展了视觉-语言预训练到多语言场景。④摘要未提供具体数据，但属于多模态预训练领域的扩展研究。
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.summary_en: This paper proposes UC2 for universal cross-lingual cross-modal vision-and-language pre-training. It introduces unified training tasks to handle multiple languages and visual inputs. The work extends VLP to multilingual settings, though no specific results are reported.
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.assessment: 对多语言多模态预训练有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知相关性较低。
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.contribution: 提出跨语言跨模态的通用预训练框架。
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.innovation: 统一多语言和视觉的预训练任务设计。
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal._arxiv_id: UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal Vision-and-Language Pre-Training.

Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对非对齐多模态序列的情感识别问题，提出渐进式模态强化方法。②通过逐步增强各模态特征并融合，处理模态间时序不对齐。③相比已有工作，强调渐进式学习策略。④摘要未提供具体数据，且领域为情感计算，与自动驾驶无关。
Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H.summary_en: This paper addresses human multimodal emotion recognition from unaligned sequences. It proposes progressive modality reinforcement to enhance features and handle temporal misalignment. The method focuses on gradual learning, but no specific results are reported.
Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H.assessment: 属于情感计算领域，与用户研究领域相关性低。
Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H.contribution: 提出渐进式模态强化用于情感识别。
Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H.innovation: 渐进式处理非对齐多模态序列。
Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H._arxiv_id: Progressive Modality Reinforcement for Human Multimodal Emotion Recognition From Unaligned Multimodal Sequences.

Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对跨模态行人重识别中互信息估计困难的问题。②提出了变分蒸馏方法，通过变分推断替代互信息进行知识迁移。③相比传统基于互信息的方法，避免了高方差估计，提高了训练稳定性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但理论上提升了跨模态匹配性能。
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of mutual information estimation in cross-modal person re-identification. It proposes a variational distillation method that replaces mutual information with variational inference for knowledge transfer. Compared to traditional mutual information-based methods, it avoids high-variance estimation and improves training stability. The abstract lacks specific results, but theoretically enhances cross-modal matching performance.
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，但变分蒸馏在跨模态任务中具有潜在价值。
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.contribution: 提出变分蒸馏框架用于跨模态行人重识别。
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.innovation: 用变分推断替代互信息估计。
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.result: 理论上提升跨模态匹配性能。
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio._arxiv_id: Farewell to Mutual Information: Variational Distillation for Cross-Modal Person Re-Identification.

2111.12341|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对事件相机数据缺乏标注、难以训练端到端模型的问题。②提出了EvDistill方法，通过双向重建引导的跨模态知识蒸馏，从图像域教师网络向事件域学生网络迁移知识，无需配对数据。③相比已有工作，创新性地引入双向模态重建模块，利用未配对数据构造蒸馏对，并在推理时无额外计算。④实验表明该方法在多个事件数据任务上显著提升了性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2111.12341|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of labeled event camera data for end-task learning. It proposes EvDistill, a bidirectional reconstruction-guided cross-modal knowledge distillation method that transfers knowledge from an image-domain teacher to an event-domain student without paired data. Compared to prior works, it introduces a bidirectional modality reconstruction module to create distillation pairs from unpaired data, with no extra inference cost. Experiments show significant performance improvements on multiple event-based tasks, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.
2111.12341|v2.assessment: 针对事件相机数据稀缺问题提出创新蒸馏框架，具有实际应用价值。
2111.12341|v2.contribution: 提出EvDistill，实现无配对跨模态知识蒸馏。
2111.12341|v2.innovation: 双向重建引导的跨模态蒸馏。
2111.12341|v2.result: 在事件数据任务上显著提升性能。

Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对图像到混响脉冲响应合成的问题。②提出了跨模态方法，利用图像信息生成对应的声学混响。③相比已有工作，可能结合视觉和音频特征进行合成。④摘要未提供具体数据。
Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse.summary_en: This paper addresses image-to-reverb impulse response synthesis. It proposes a cross-modal method that uses image information to generate corresponding acoustic reverberation. Compared to prior works, it may combine visual and audio features for synthesis. The abstract lacks specific results.
Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse.assessment: 摘要不完整，但跨模态合成方向有创意。
Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse.contribution: 提出图像驱动的混响合成方法。
Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse.innovation: 跨模态图像到音频合成。
Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse._arxiv_id: Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse Response Synthesis.

Multi-Modal Multi-Action Video Recogniti.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对多模态多动作视频识别问题。②提出了融合多种模态信息进行动作识别的方法。③相比已有工作，可能处理多动作同时发生的场景。④摘要未提供具体数据。
Multi-Modal Multi-Action Video Recogniti.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-modal multi-action video recognition. It proposes methods to fuse multiple modalities for action recognition. Multi-Modal Multi-Action Video Recogniti.contribution: 提出多模态多动作识别方法。
Multi-Modal Multi-Action Video Recogniti.innovation: 处理多动作同时发生的场景。

Learning an Augmented RGB Representation.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对动作检测中RGB表示信息不足的问题。②提出了学习增强RGB表示的方法，通过跨模态知识蒸馏从其他模态（如光流）迁移知识。③相比已有工作，增强了RGB特征的判别力，避免推理时依赖额外模态。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期提升动作检测精度。
Learning an Augmented RGB Representation.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient RGB representation for action detection. It proposes learning an augmented RGB representation via cross-modal knowledge distillation from other modalities like optical flow. Compared to prior works, it enhances RGB feature discriminability without extra modalities at inference. The abstract lacks specific results, but expected to improve action detection accuracy.
Learning an Augmented RGB Representation.assessment: 跨模态蒸馏增强RGB表示，对动作检测有实用价值。
Learning an Augmented RGB Representation.contribution: 提出跨模态蒸馏增强RGB表示。
Learning an Augmented RGB Representation.result: 预期提升动作检测精度。
Learning an Augmented RGB Representation._arxiv_id: Learning an Augmented RGB Representation with Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Action Detection.

2012.04124|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对多模态Transformer参数过多、内存需求高的问题。②提出了参数高效的多模态Transformer，通过跨层和跨模态共享参数，并分解为模态特定和共享部分，结合低秩近似。③相比已有工作，大幅减少参数，允许端到端训练。④实验表明参数减少高达97%，并提出了基于实例相似度的负采样方法，具体性能数据未在摘要中给出。
2012.04124|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the excessive parameters and memory requirements of multimodal Transformers. It proposes parameter-efficient multimodal Transformers by sharing parameters across layers and modalities, decomposing into modality-specific and shared parts, and using low-rank approximation. Compared to prior works, it drastically reduces parameters, enabling end-to-end training. Experiments show up to 97% parameter reduction, with a proposed negative sampling method; specific performance numbers are not in the abstract.
2012.04124|v2.assessment: 参数高效设计对多模态视频学习有重要贡献，具有广泛适用性。
2012.04124|v2.innovation: 跨层跨模态参数共享和低秩分解。
2012.04124|v2.result: 参数减少97%，支持端到端训练。

2007.01179|v2.summary_cn: ① 针对多模态生成模型训练需要大量“相关”配对数据、成本高昂的问题。② 提出一种对比学习框架，通过区分“相关”与“不相关”的多模态数据来训练生成模型，而非仅依赖模态间的共性。③ 相比传统方法，该框架能利用大量未标注、未配对的多模态数据，提升数据效率。④ 实验表明，在多种多模态VAE模型上，该方法在具有挑战性的数据集上实现了数据高效学习，并能准确区分相关与不相关样本。
2007.01179|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of paired multimodal data for generative models by proposing a contrastive framework that learns from both commonality and distinction between related and unrelated multimodal samples. It enables data-efficient learning and effective use of unpaired data, as demonstrated on challenging datasets with various multimodal VAEs.
2007.01179|v2.assessment: 该工作对多模态生成学习的数据效率问题提供了新思路，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知）相关性较低。
2007.01179|v2.contribution: 提出一种数据高效的多模态生成模型对比学习框架。
2007.01179|v2.innovation: 利用相关与不相关样本的对比信号辅助生成模型训练。
2007.01179|v2.result: 在多个数据集上实现数据高效的多模态生成学习。

2105.02470|v2.summary_cn: ① 针对现有自监督多模态生成模型在语义连贯性与联合数据分布学习之间存在权衡的问题。② 提出一种广义多模态ELBO公式，统一了两种先前方法作为特例，并兼顾两者优势。③ 相比已有方法，新目标函数无需妥协即可同时优化语义连贯性和联合分布学习。④ 在广泛的自监督生成学习实验中，该方法优于现有最先进模型。
2105.02470|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the trade-off between semantic coherence and joint distribution learning in multimodal generative models by proposing a generalized ELBO formulation that subsumes two prior methods. The new objective combines their benefits without compromise and outperforms state-of-the-art models in extensive self-supervised generative experiments.
2105.02470|v2.assessment: 理论贡献扎实，但主题偏向多模态生成模型，与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联不大。
2105.02470|v2.contribution: 提出广义多模态ELBO目标函数。
2105.02470|v2.innovation: 统一了两种多模态ELBO方法并消除其局限性。
2105.02470|v2.result: 在自监督生成任务上超越现有最先进方法。

2107.00860|v2.summary_cn: ① 针对传统NAS方法针对单一任务搜索架构、计算成本高且难以跨数据集泛化的问题。② 提出MetaD2A框架，在包含数据集和预训练网络的数据库上训练一次，即可快速为新数据集生成架构，通过跨模态潜空间和摊销元学习实现。③ 相比已有方法，无需从零搜索，显著降低计算成本。④ 实验表明该模型能有效生成架构，并利用元性能预测器选择最优架构。
2107.00860|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost and poor generalization of task-specific NAS by proposing MetaD2A, a framework trained once on a database of datasets and networks to rapidly generate architectures for novel datasets via amortized meta-learning. It also introduces a meta-performance predictor for architecture selection, reducing computational cost.
2107.00860|v2.assessment: NAS方向有一定价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心领域相关性较低。
