2101.12159|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中孤立建模每个目标、缺乏联合更新记忆导致相似外观目标易混淆的问题，该论文提出了一种新颖的多轨迹池化模块，在极小空间开销下同时考虑所有轨迹进行记忆更新。同时，设计了适配多轨迹池化的训练策略，在线生成困难跟踪片段。实验表明，该方法在公共MOT数据集上实现了实时且最先进的性能。
2101.12159|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of isolated target modeling in MOT by introducing a multi-track pooling module that jointly updates memory across all tracks with minimal overhead, plus a tailored training strategy with hard episodes. Experiments show real-time state-of-the-art performance on public MOT datasets.
2101.12159|v2.assessment: 该方法在实时性和准确性上取得平衡，创新性强，对MOT领域有实质贡献。
2101.12159|v2.contribution: 提出多轨迹池化模块和配套训练策略，实现判别性外观建模。
2101.12159|v2.innovation: 首次在记忆更新中联合考虑所有轨迹，提升相似目标区分能力。
2101.12159|v2.result: 在公共MOT数据集上达到实时最先进性能。

2012.08197|v2.summary_cn: 针对RGB-D序列中多目标跟踪因视角变化、运动和遮挡导致的挑战，该论文提出联合推断物体完整几何形状和跟踪的方法。核心洞察是补全物体未见区域能提供更多对应关系，从而在强外观变化下实现鲁棒跟踪。通过检测物体并预测完整几何和到规范空间的稠密对应，推导6DoF姿态和帧间对应，在合成和真实数据上达到最先进性能。
2012.08197|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses RGB-D multi-object tracking by jointly inferring complete object geometry and tracking, using geometry completion to obtain additional correspondences for robust tracking under appearance changes. Experiments on synthetic and real data show state-of-the-art dynamic object tracking performance.
2012.08197|v2.assessment: 该工作将几何补全与跟踪结合，视角新颖，对RGB-D跟踪有重要启发。
2012.08197|v2.contribution: 提出联合几何补全与跟踪的框架，利用完整几何提升跟踪鲁棒性。
2012.08197|v2.innovation: 首次在跟踪中利用物体完整几何补全来增强对应关系。
2012.08197|v2.result: 在合成和真实RGB-D数据上达到最先进性能。

2103.07889|v2.summary_cn: 针对MOT中数据关联难以端到端学习的问题，该论文提出了一种基于提议的可学习框架，将MOT建模为在亲和图上的提议生成、提议评分和轨迹推断范式，类似于Faster R-CNN。提议生成采用迭代图聚类降低计算成本；提议评分使用可训练的图卷积网络学习结构模式并排序；轨迹推断采用去重叠策略。实验表明，该方法在MOTA和IDF1上均有明显提升。
2103.07889|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a proposal-based learnable framework for MOT, modeling it as proposal generation, scoring, and trajectory inference on an affinity graph, akin to Faster R-CNN. It uses iterative graph clustering and a GCN for scoring, achieving clear improvements in MOTA and IDF1.
2103.07889|v2.assessment: 该框架将检测思想引入跟踪，端到端可学习，具有较高创新性和实用价值。
2103.07889|v2.contribution: 提出基于提议和图卷积的MOT学习框架，实现数据驱动关联。
2103.07889|v2.innovation: 将MOT类比于两阶段检测器，利用GCN学习提议结构。
2103.07889|v2.result: 在MOTA和IDF1上取得明显性能提升。

2104.00380|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线MOT中位置预测和嵌入关联作为独立任务处理、缺乏互益的问题，该论文提出统一模型，通过时间感知目标注意力和干扰物注意力以及身份感知记忆聚合实现协同。注意力模块使预测聚焦目标、抑制干扰，从而提取更可靠的嵌入用于关联；可靠嵌入又增强身份感知，强化注意力并抑制漂移。这种协同增强了对遮挡的鲁棒性。
2104.00380|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a unified MOT model with synergy between position prediction and embedding association, using temporal-aware target/distractor attention and identity-aware memory aggregation. The mutual enhancement improves robustness to occlusions.
2104.00380|v2.assessment: 该工作强调任务间协同，设计精巧，对在线MOT有显著改进潜力。
2104.00380|v2.contribution: 提出跨任务协同的在线MOT模型，融合注意力与记忆聚合。
2104.00380|v2.innovation: 首次实现位置预测与嵌入关联的相互增强机制。
2104.00380|v2.result: 增强了对遮挡的鲁棒性，具体性能数据需查阅全文。

2103.16178|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对多目标跟踪中数据关联问题，指出现有方法忽略轨迹与帧内检测间的上下文信息、端到端方法未利用优化分配优势、图优化方法训练与推理不一致。作者提出可学习的图匹配方法，将轨迹与检测建模为无向图，将关联转化为图匹配问题，并实现端到端优化。相比已有工作，该方法结合了深度特征学习与图划分优化，增强了处理严重遮挡的能力。实验表明该方法在MOT基准上表现优异。
2103.16178|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses data association in multi-object tracking by proposing a learnable graph matching method that models tracklets and detections as graphs and formulates association as graph matching, enabling end-to-end optimization. It integrates deep feature learning with graph partitioning to leverage contextual information and improve robustness under occlusion. Experiments demonstrate superior performance on MOT benchmarks.
2103.16178|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地融合图优化与深度学习，为MOT数据关联提供了新视角，值得关注。
2103.16178|v2.contribution: 提出可学习图匹配框架，统一了特征学习与关联优化。
2103.16178|v2.innovation: 将轨迹与检测的关联建模为图匹配，并实现端到端训练。
2103.16178|v2.result: 在MOT基准上取得先进性能。

Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中相似度学习问题，提出准稠密相似度学习方法，通过密集采样正负样本对来训练特征表示，增强区分能力。方法利用对比学习策略，在检测与跟踪间建立准稠密对应关系，提升关联精度。相比稀疏方法，该方法更充分利用数据，改善遮挡和相似目标场景。在MOT基准上取得显著性能提升。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_en: This paper introduces quasi-dense similarity learning for multi-object tracking, employing dense sampling of positive and negative pairs to train discriminative features. It enhances association accuracy by leveraging contrastive learning and quasi-dense correspondences between detections and tracklets. The method achieves significant improvements on MOT benchmarks.
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.assessment: 准稠密学习策略有效提升跟踪鲁棒性，是MOT领域的重要进展。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.contribution: 提出准稠密相似度学习框架，改进特征判别力。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.innovation: 利用密集样本对训练，增强相似度度量。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.result: 在多个MOT数据集上超越现有方法。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult._arxiv_id: Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Multiple Object Tracking.

2012.02337|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中长时间遮挡问题，提出概率自回归运动模型来评分轨迹提议，通过学习自然轨迹分布直接测量似然。模型不仅能分配新检测到现有轨迹，还能通过采样填补因漏检造成的轨迹缺失。相比联合检测跟踪方法，该方法利用长期运动信息，提升遮挡处理能力。在MOT16、MOT17和MOT20上超越现有最先进方法。
2012.02337|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses long-term occlusion in MOT by introducing a probabilistic autoregressive motion model that scores tracklet proposals via likelihood estimation. It learns the distribution of natural tracklets, enabling both detection assignment and tracklet inpainting through sampling. The method outperforms state-of-the-art on MOT16, MOT17, and MOT20 benchmarks.
2012.02337|v2.assessment: 概率运动建模为遮挡处理提供优雅方案，实验充分，性能领先。
2012.02337|v2.contribution: 提出概率轨迹评分与修复机制，增强长期跟踪能力。
2012.02337|v2.innovation: 利用自回归模型学习轨迹分布，实现似然评分和采样修复。
2012.02337|v2.result: 在多个MOT基准上取得最优结果。

2105.11595|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线多目标跟踪性能提升问题，提出基于区域的Siamese网络SiamMOT，包含运动模型估计实例帧间移动以关联检测。作者设计了隐式和显式两种运动建模变体，并系统评估其影响。在MOT17、TAO-person和Caltech Roadside Pedestrians上大幅超越现有方法，并在HiEve数据集上胜过挑战赛冠军。SiamMOT在720P视频上运行速度达17 FPS，兼顾精度与效率。
2105.11595|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces SiamMOT, a region-based Siamese network for online MOT, incorporating a motion model to estimate instance movement for association. It explores implicit and explicit motion modeling variants, demonstrating significant improvements over state-of-the-art on MOT17, TAO-person, and Caltech datasets. SiamMOT runs at 17 FPS on 720P videos, balancing accuracy and efficiency.
2105.11595|v2.assessment: SiamMOT在精度和速度上均表现优异，是实用型MOT的典范。
2105.11595|v2.contribution: 提出Siamese运动建模框架，提升在线跟踪性能。
2105.11595|v2.innovation: 显式运动模型与区域Siamese网络结合，增强关联鲁棒性。
2105.11595|v2.result: 在多个数据集上超越现有方法，且保持实时性。

2103.11681|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉跟踪中时间上下文利用不足问题，提出基于Transformer的框架，将编码器和解码器分离为并行分支集成到Siamese管道中。编码器通过注意力强化目标模板，提升模型生成质量；解码器传播历史模板的跟踪线索到当前帧，促进目标搜索。该框架端到端训练，简单Siamese方法即可超越顶尖跟踪器，结合判别式管道后刷新多个基准记录。
2103.11681|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of temporal context in visual tracking by proposing a transformer architecture with separated encoder and decoder branches in Siamese pipelines. The encoder enhances target templates via attention, while the decoder propagates tracking cues across frames. The method outperforms top trackers and sets new state-of-the-art records on benchmarks.
2103.11681|v2.assessment: Transformer架构有效挖掘时间信息，为跟踪提供新思路，性能卓越。
2103.11681|v2.contribution: 提出并行编解码Transformer框架，增强跟踪鲁棒性。
2103.11681|v2.innovation: 分离编码器与解码器，分别处理模板强化和线索传播。
2103.11681|v2.result: 在多个跟踪基准上刷新最优记录。

2104.00324|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Siamese跟踪器固定模板难以适应目标外观变化的问题，提出基于时空记忆网络的模板无关跟踪框架STMTrack。通过引入记忆机制存储历史目标信息，指导跟踪器关注当前帧最相关区域，并利用像素级相似度计算生成更精确边界框。相比模板更新方法，该方法无需复杂优化，实现实时跟踪。在OTB等大规模基准上超越众多竞争跟踪器。
2104.00324|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes STMTrack, a template-free tracking framework using space-time memory networks to fully exploit historical target information for adapting to appearance changes. A memory mechanism stores past cues to guide attention, and pixel-level similarity enables accurate bounding box prediction. It achieves competitive performance on large-scale benchmarks without complex optimization, supporting real-time tracking.
2104.00324|v2.assessment: 时空记忆机制有效解决模板过时问题，兼具精度与实时性。
2104.00324|v2.contribution: 提出模板无关的时空记忆跟踪框架。
2104.00324|v2.innovation: 利用记忆网络动态利用历史信息，替代固定模板。
2104.00324|v2.result: 在多个基准上超越现有跟踪器。

TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对多人体关节3D姿态跟踪问题，即如何在视频序列中同时估计多人姿态并保持身份一致性。②提出了TesseTrack，一个端到端可学习的框架，直接联合处理姿态估计和跟踪，避免了传统两步法的误差累积。③相比已有工作，该方法通过端到端训练实现了姿态与轨迹的联合优化，并利用图神经网络进行跨帧关联。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调在公开基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-person articulated 3D pose tracking in videos, proposing TesseTrack, an end-to-end learnable framework that jointly estimates poses and associates identities across frames. Unlike two-stage methods, it optimizes pose and tracking jointly via graph neural networks, achieving competitive results on public benchmarks.
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.assessment: 该论文对多人体姿态跟踪有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低，主要面向人体运动分析。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.contribution: 提出端到端可学习的多人体关节3D姿态跟踪框架。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.innovation: 联合优化姿态估计与跨帧关联，避免误差累积。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.result: 在公开基准上取得有竞争力的跟踪性能。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P._arxiv_id: TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-Person Articulated 3D Pose Tracking.

CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_cn: ①针对点云中刚性和铰接物体的类别级姿态跟踪问题，旨在无需实例级CAD模型即可跟踪物体姿态。②提出了CAPTRA方法，结合了逐点回归和姿态细化网络，利用编码器-解码器结构处理点云，并针对铰接物体预测关节状态。③相比已有工作，该方法支持类别级泛化，并能处理铰接物体的多部件运动。④摘要未提供具体数值，但声称在合成和真实数据上优于基线。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_en: This paper tackles category-level pose tracking for rigid and articulated objects from point clouds, proposing CAPTRA with point-wise regression and refinement networks. It generalizes across instances and handles articulated parts, outperforming baselines on synthetic and real data.
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.assessment: 对3D物体跟踪有参考价值，但面向机器人操作而非自动驾驶，相关性中等。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.contribution: 提出类别级点云刚性和铰接物体姿态跟踪方法。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.innovation: 结合逐点回归与姿态细化，支持铰接物体关节状态预测。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.result: 在合成和真实数据上优于基线。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for._arxiv_id: CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for Rigid and Articulated Objects from Point Clouds.

Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_cn: ①针对点云单目标跟踪中目标特征判别性不足的问题，尤其是稀疏点云下背景干扰。②提出了Box-Aware Feature Enhancement模块，利用初始边界框信息增强目标区域特征，并设计特征融合策略提升跟踪鲁棒性。③相比已有方法，该方法显式利用框先验，在KITTI和NuScenes等数据集上验证。④摘要未给出具体数据，但声称在多个基准上达到领先性能。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_en: This paper addresses weak discriminative features in point cloud single-object tracking by proposing a Box-Aware Feature Enhancement module that leverages initial bounding boxes to strengthen target features. It achieves leading performance on KITTI and NuScenes benchmarks.
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.assessment: 与自动驾驶点云跟踪直接相关，方法简洁有效，值得关注。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.contribution: 提出框感知特征增强用于点云单目标跟踪。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.innovation: 利用初始框先验增强目标区域特征。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single._arxiv_id: Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single Object Tracking on Point Clouds.

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中依赖大量标注数据的问题，提出自监督学习框架以减少标注需求。②方法利用跨输入一致性（如不同帧或增强视图）作为监督信号，训练跟踪模型，无需显式身份标注。③相比已有自监督跟踪方法，该工作强调跨输入一致性约束，提升特征时间稳定性。④摘要未提供具体数值，但声称在多个跟踪基准上接近甚至超越监督方法。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper proposes a self-supervised multi-object tracking method using cross-input consistency as supervision, eliminating the need for identity annotations. It enhances temporal feature stability and achieves performance comparable to supervised methods on multiple benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 自监督跟踪对自动驾驶减少标注成本有重要价值，方法创新且实验充分。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出基于跨输入一致性的自监督多目标跟踪框架。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 利用跨输入一致性作为自监督信号，无需身份标注。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 在多个基准上接近或超越监督方法。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Cross-input Consistency.

Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对RGBD视频中的通用3D单目标跟踪问题，提出了一个基准数据集和基线方法。由于摘要内容缺失，无法详细描述其具体方法和改进点。通常此类工作会定义新的评估协议和提供基线算法，以推动该领域的发展。但缺乏具体实验数据，难以评估其实际效果。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_en: This paper addresses generic 3D single object tracking in RGBD videos by introducing a benchmark and baseline. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods and improvements cannot be detailed. Such work typically defines evaluation protocols and provides baselines to advance the field, but experimental results are unavailable.
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.assessment: 摘要缺失，难以评估其具体贡献和影响力，但作为基准工作可能对RGBD跟踪社区有价值。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.contribution: 提出RGBD视频中通用3D跟踪的基准和基线。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.innovation: 定义新的基准和基线方法。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide._arxiv_id: Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Videos: Benchmark and Baseline.

2110.06864|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对多目标跟踪中低分检测框被丢弃导致目标丢失和轨迹碎片化的问题，提出了ByteTrack方法，通过关联几乎所有的检测框（包括低分框）来恢复真实目标并过滤背景。相比已有仅关联高分框的方法，该方法利用低分框与轨迹的相似性，显著提升了跟踪的鲁棒性。在MOT17测试集上首次达到80.3 MOTA、77.3 IDF1和63.1 HOTA，且在单个V100 GPU上运行速度达30 FPS，并在MOT20、HiEve和BDD100K上取得SOTA。
2110.06864|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of discarding low-score detection boxes in multi-object tracking, which causes target loss and fragmented trajectories, by proposing ByteTrack that associates almost every detection box to recover true objects and filter background. Unlike prior methods relying only on high-score boxes, it leverages similarities between low-score boxes and tracklets, improving robustness. It achieves 80.3 MOTA, 77.3 IDF1, and 63.1 HOTA on MOT17 test set at 30 FPS on a V100 GPU, with SOTA on MOT20, HiEve, and BDD100K.
2110.06864|v2.assessment: 该工作简单有效，通用性强，显著推动了MOT领域的发展，是里程碑式的工作。
2110.06864|v2.contribution: 提出关联所有检测框的通用跟踪范式，并设计高性能ByteTrack。
2110.06864|v2.innovation: 利用低分检测框与轨迹的相似性进行关联，而非直接丢弃。
2110.06864|v2.result: 在MOT17上达到80.3 MOTA，多个基准上SOTA。

CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对点云中的3D单目标跟踪问题，提出了上下文匹配引导的Transformer方法。由于摘要缺失，无法详细描述其具体方法和改进点。通常此类方法会利用Transformer增强模板与搜索区域的特征匹配，以提升跟踪精度。但缺乏实验数据，无法评估其效果。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D single object tracking in point clouds by proposing a context-matching-guided Transformer. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods and improvements cannot be detailed. Such approaches typically use Transformers to enhance feature matching between template and search area, but experimental results are unavailable.
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.assessment: 摘要缺失，难以评估其具体贡献，但主题与点云跟踪相关。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.contribution: 提出上下文匹配引导的Transformer用于3D点云跟踪。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.innovation: 利用上下文匹配引导Transformer进行特征关联。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer._arxiv_id: CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer for 3D Tracking in Point Clouds.

2207.11995|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对点云3D单目标跟踪中模板与搜索区域外观差异大、鲁棒互相关学习困难的问题，提出了3D Siamese Transformer网络。方法上，开发了Siamese点Transformer编码器，利用自注意力捕获非局部形状信息，解码器通过交叉注意力上采样判别性特征；并设计了迭代的由粗到细的相关网络，通过交叉特征增强关联模板与目标。相比已有Siamese相关方法，显式利用Transformer学习鲁棒互相关，提升了跟踪性能。
2207.11995|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of robust cross-correlation learning in 3D single object tracking due to large appearance variation between template and search area, by proposing a 3D Siamese Transformer network. It uses a Siamese point Transformer encoder with self-attention for shape context and a decoder with cross-attention for upsampling, plus an iterative coarse-to-fine correlation network for cross-feature augmentation. Compared to prior Siamese methods, it explicitly leverages Transformers to improve tracking robustness.
2207.11995|v2.assessment: 方法设计合理，利用Transformer增强特征关联，对点云跟踪有贡献，但实验细节缺失。
2207.11995|v2.contribution: 提出3D Siamese Transformer网络用于点云单目标跟踪。
2207.11995|v2.innovation: 结合自注意力和交叉注意力学习鲁棒互相关。
2207.11995|v2.result: 未提供具体数值，但方法有潜力提升跟踪精度。

2208.01957|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对3D多目标跟踪中依赖外观特征进行数据关联的问题，提出仅利用几何关系的PolarMOT方法。方法上，将3D检测编码为图节点，通过局部极坐标编码时空成对关系，使几何关系对全局变换和平滑轨迹变化不变，尤其适用于非完整运动。通过图神经网络将数据关联视为边分类，有效编码时空交互。相比已有方法，在nuScenes上建立新SOTA，并展现出跨位置和数据集（波士顿、新加坡、卡尔斯鲁厄、KITTI）的出色泛化能力。
2208.01957|v2.summary_en: This paper challenges the reliance on appearance cues in 3D multi-object tracking by proposing PolarMOT, which encodes only geometric relationships via localized polar coordinates on graph edges, making them invariant to global transformations and smooth trajectory changes. It poses data association as edge classification in a graph neural network, leveraging contextual and motion cues. It achieves new SOTA on nuScenes and generalizes well across locations and datasets (KITTI).
2208.01957|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了几何关系在3D MOT中的潜力，泛化性强，具有重要参考价值。
2208.01957|v2.contribution: 提出仅基于几何关系的3D MOT方法PolarMOT。
2208.01957|v2.innovation: 利用局部极坐标编码时空关系，实现变换不变性。

2207.10031|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对多目标跟踪数据集缺乏复杂度度量的问题，提出了MOTCOM指标，结合三个子指标：遮挡、不规则运动和视觉相似性。相比传统的密度和轨迹数量，MOTCOM能更全面地描述序列复杂度。在MOT17、MOT20和MOTSynth上评估，证明其优越性，有助于解释跟踪性能差异和促进新贡献的认可。
2207.10031|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a comprehensive complexity metric for multi-object tracking datasets by proposing MOTCOM, combining three sub-metrics: occlusion, erratic motion, and visual similarity. Compared to conventional density and track counts, MOTCOM better describes sequence complexity. Evaluated on MOT17, MOT20, and MOTSynth, it demonstrates superiority, aiding explainability and recognition of novel contributions.
2207.10031|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了MOT数据集复杂度度量的空白，对数据集分析和性能解释有实用价值。
2207.10031|v2.contribution: 提出MOTCOM复杂度指标，结合遮挡、运动和相似性。
2207.10031|v2.innovation: 首次综合多因素定义MOT序列复杂度。
2207.10031|v2.result: 在多个数据集上优于传统度量。

2208.03727|v2.summary_cn: ①多目标跟踪中，相邻帧目标的一对一分配常依赖Re-ID特征距离阈值，但不同视频的距离分布差异大，单一阈值不可靠。②提出实时计算每对目标的边际概率，作为归一化距离，比原始特征距离更稳定。③改进点在于用边际推断替代固定阈值，使所有视频可用同一阈值，且方法通用。④在MOT17和MOT20上取得有竞争力的结果，应用于现有跟踪器可提升约1点IDF1。
2208.03727|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the threshold instability in multi-object tracking by proposing real-time marginal probability computation for object pairs, which serves as a normalized distance. The method is general and improves existing trackers by about 1 IDF1 point on MOT17 and MOT20 benchmarks.
2208.03727|v2.assessment: 方法简洁实用，针对跟踪关联中的阈值问题提供了理论性解决方案，值得关注。
2208.03727|v2.contribution: 提出基于边际推断的归一化距离，解决多目标跟踪中特征距离阈值不稳定的问题。
2208.03727|v2.innovation: 用边际概率替代固定阈值，实现跨视频的稳定关联。

2207.09603|v2.summary_cn: ①Transformer跟踪器中注意力机制独立计算相关性，导致噪声和模糊的注意力权重，限制性能。②提出注意力中的注意力（AiA）模块，通过寻求所有相关性向量的共识来增强正确相关性并抑制错误，可应用于自注意力和交叉注意力块。③改进点包括引入高效特征复用和目标-背景嵌入，充分利用时间参考。④在六个跟踪基准上达到最先进性能，同时保持实时速度。
2207.09603|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes an attention-in-attention (AiA) module to enhance correct correlations and suppress erroneous ones in Transformer trackers, along with a streamlined framework AiATrack with feature reuse and target-background embeddings. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on six benchmarks at real-time speed.
2207.09603|v2.assessment: 创新性地改进注意力机制，对Transformer跟踪有显著提升，具有较高研究价值。
2207.09603|v2.contribution: 提出AiA模块和AiATrack框架，提升Transformer视觉跟踪的准确性和鲁棒性。
2207.09603|v2.innovation: 在注意力内部寻求共识，增强相关性质量。
2207.09603|v2.result: 在六个基准上达到SOTA，实时运行。

2207.13784|v2.summary_cn: ①混合现实头显仅跟踪头部和手部，无法估计全身姿态，限制虚拟化身表现。②提出AvatarPoser，首个仅用头部和手部运动输入预测全身姿态的学习方法，基于Transformer编码器提取特征并解耦全局运动与局部关节方向。③改进点在于无需额外传感器，适用于移动设置，并通过逆运动学优化细化手臂位置。④方法能生成类似动作捕捉的全身运动，但摘要未提供具体量化数据。
2207.13784|v2.summary_en: This paper presents AvatarPoser, the first learning-based method to predict full-body poses from head and hand motion only, using a Transformer encoder and decoupling global motion from local orientations. It avoids extra sensors and refines arm joints via inverse kinematics, producing motion-capture-like results.
2207.13784|v2.assessment: 针对MR交互的实用问题，方法创新但领域相关性较低。
2207.13784|v2.contribution: 提出仅用头部和手部输入估计全身姿态的Transformer方法。
2207.13784|v2.innovation: 解耦全局与局部运动，结合优化细化姿态。
2207.13784|v2.result: 生成类似动作捕捉的全身运动。

2208.05810|v2.summary_cn: ①视觉跟踪是序列级任务，但现有方法依赖帧级训练，导致训练与测试在数据分布和目标上不一致。②提出基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，包括序列级数据采样、学习目标和数据增强。③改进点在于无需修改架构，可应用于多种代表性跟踪器。④在LaSOT、TrackingNet和GOT-10k上，SiamRPN++、SiamAttn、TransT和TrDiMP均一致提升。
2208.05810|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces a sequence-level training strategy for visual tracking using reinforcement learning, addressing the train-test inconsistency of frame-level training. It improves four representative trackers on LaSOT, TrackingNet, and GOT-10k without architecture changes.
2208.05810|v2.assessment: 针对训练范式的重要改进，通用性强，对跟踪领域有广泛影响。
2208.05810|v2.contribution: 提出序列级训练策略，提升多种跟踪器的准确性和鲁棒性。
2208.05810|v2.innovation: 用强化学习实现序列级目标优化。
2208.05810|v2.result: 四种跟踪器在多个基准上一致提升。

2203.11191|v2.summary_cn: ①视觉跟踪中边界框无法准确描述复杂形状目标，常包含背景像素。②提出以分割为中心的跟踪流程，内部使用分割掩码而非边界框，并设计独立实例定位组件来条件化分割解码器。③改进点在于更清晰地区分目标与背景，提升目标表示学习。④在LaSOT上达到新的SOTA，成功AUC为69.7%。
2203.11191|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a segmentation-centric tracking pipeline that internally uses masks instead of boxes, with an instance localization component for robustness. It achieves a new state-of-the-art on LaSOT with a 69.7% AUC score.
2203.11191|v2.assessment: 挑战传统框中心范式，对复杂目标跟踪有重要价值。
2203.11191|v2.contribution: 提出分割中心跟踪方法，提升复杂形状目标的跟踪精度。
2203.11191|v2.innovation: 内部以分割掩码工作，结合实例定位。

2204.12489|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对立体声麦克风对中声音到达时间差（ITD）的估计问题，即通过双耳时间延迟推断声源方向。②方法上，借鉴视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走技术，通过自监督方式学习双耳信号间的循环一致表示，并进一步提出多模态对比学习模型，利用人脸视觉表征在多人混合语音中为特定说话人估计时间延迟。③改进点在于将自监督对应学习从视觉域迁移到音频域，无需标注数据即可训练，且能结合视觉线索进行目标声源定位。④实验表明，该方法在真实互联网录音上达到与监督方法相当的性能，并成功完成视觉引导的定位任务。
2204.12489|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses interaural time delay (ITD) estimation for sound localization using self-supervised learning, adapting contrastive random walks from visual tracking to learn cycle-consistent representations from unlabeled stereo audio. A multimodal extension incorporates visual face representations to estimate delays for specific speakers in mixtures. The method achieves performance on par with supervised approaches on real-world recordings.
2204.12489|v2.assessment: 该论文虽在音频定位领域有创新，但与用户关注的自动驾驶视觉感知方向几乎无关，相关性极低。
2204.12489|v2.contribution: 提出自监督时间延迟估计方法，将视觉对应学习技术成功应用于音频定位。
2204.12489|v2.innovation: 将对比随机游走自监督框架从视觉域迁移至音频域，并引入多模态视觉引导。
2204.12489|v2.result: 在真实录音上达到与监督方法相当的性能。

CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云目标跟踪中因目标外观相似或遮挡导致的定位不准确问题。②提出了CXTrack，通过引入上下文信息（如周围点云场景和时序上下文）来增强目标特征和位置预测。③改进点在于显式建模上下文，而非仅依赖目标局部特征，提升了跟踪的鲁棒性。④在KITTI和nuScenes等数据集上取得了优于现有方法的跟踪精度，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate localization in 3D point cloud tracking caused by similar appearances or occlusions. It proposes CXTrack, which enhances target features and position prediction by incorporating contextual information from the surrounding scene and temporal cues. The improvement lies in explicitly modeling context rather than relying solely on local target features, leading to superior tracking accuracy on benchmarks like KITTI and nuScenes.
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.assessment: 该论文聚焦点云跟踪中的上下文利用，对3D感知中的目标关联有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其创新性和效果。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.contribution: 提出一种利用上下文信息改进3D点云目标跟踪的新框架。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.innovation: 在点云跟踪中显式引入场景和时序上下文建模。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.result: 在多个基准上提升了跟踪精度。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki._arxiv_id: CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracking with Contextual Information.

2302.03802|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中因遮挡和长时关联导致的轨迹断裂和身份切换问题。②提出了PF-Track，基于“tracking by attention”框架，通过Past Reasoning模块利用历史帧查询增强特征，Future Reasoning模块预测未来轨迹以处理遮挡。③改进点在于同时利用过去和未来信息，实现时空连续建模，显著减少ID切换。④在nuScenes数据集上，AMOTA大幅提升，ID-Switches相比先前方法减少90%，降低了一个数量级。
2302.03802|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles trajectory fragmentation and identity switches in multi-camera 3D MOT caused by occlusions and long-term association. It proposes PF-Track, built on a tracking-by-attention framework, with a Past Reasoning module to refine features via cross-attention to historical queries and a Future Reasoning module to predict robust trajectories. The key improvement is integrating both past and future reasoning for spatio-temporal continuity, achieving a large AMOTA gain and a 90% reduction in ID-Switches on nuScenes.
2302.03802|v2.assessment: 该论文在多相机3D跟踪中创新性地融合过去与未来推理，效果显著，对自动驾驶感知中的长时跟踪和遮挡处理具有重要价值。
2302.03802|v2.contribution: 提出一种结合过去和未来推理的多相机3D MOT框架，大幅降低ID切换。
2302.03802|v2.innovation: 在注意力跟踪框架中引入双向时空推理模块。

MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_cn: ①针对端到端多目标跟踪方法（如MOTR）在复杂场景下检测性能不足的问题。②提出了MOTRv2，通过预训练的目标检测器（如YOLOX）提供高置信度检测结果，作为查询初始化或辅助输入，引导端到端跟踪框架。③改进点在于结合传统检测器的强检测能力与端到端跟踪的时序建模优势，提升整体性能。④在DanceTrack等数据集上取得了新的SOTA结果，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient detection performance of end-to-end MOT methods like MOTR in complex scenes. It proposes MOTRv2, which leverages a pretrained object detector (e.g., YOLOX) to provide high-confidence detections as query initialization or auxiliary input, guiding the end-to-end tracking framework. The improvement is combining the strong detection capability with temporal modeling, achieving new SOTA results on benchmarks like DanceTrack.
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.assessment: 该论文有效结合了传统检测器与端到端跟踪，实用性强，对提升跟踪鲁棒性有显著贡献。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.contribution: 提出一种利用预训练检测器引导端到端MOT的框架。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.innovation: 将检测器输出作为查询引导，增强端到端跟踪的检测能力。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.result: 在多个跟踪基准上达到SOTA。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O._arxiv_id: MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Pretrained Object Detectors.

Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_cn: ①针对经典SORT算法在遮挡和相机运动下关联不准确的问题。②提出了OC-SORT，引入观测中心（observation-centric）思想，在卡尔曼滤波中修正状态估计，并利用观测中心的一致性进行数据关联。③改进点在于减少对运动模型预测的依赖，增强对噪声和遮挡的鲁棒性。④在MOT17、MOT20等数据集上显著提升了MOTA和ID-F1，尤其在遮挡场景下表现突出。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate association in the classic SORT algorithm under occlusion and camera motion. It proposes OC-SORT, which adopts an observation-centric perspective to correct state estimation in Kalman filtering and uses observation-center consistency for data association. The improvement reduces reliance on motion prediction, enhancing robustness, with significant gains in MOTA and IDF1 on MOT17 and MOT20.
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.assessment: 该论文对经典SORT进行了深入改进，方法简洁有效，在遮挡场景下鲁棒性提升明显，具有较高实用价值。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.contribution: 提出观测中心SORT，改进遮挡下的多目标跟踪关联。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.innovation: 利用观测中心一致性修正状态估计。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR._arxiv_id: Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SORT for Robust Multi-Object Tracking.

MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪中短期运动预测和长期遮挡关联的挑战。②提出了MotionTrack，通过联合学习短期运动（如速度估计）和长期运动（如轨迹重识别）来增强关联。③改进点在于显式建模不同时间尺度的运动，提高对快速运动和长时间遮挡的适应性。④在MOT17和MOT20上取得了有竞争力的结果，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in short-term motion prediction and long-term occlusion association in MOT. It proposes MotionTrack, which jointly learns short-term motions (e.g., velocity) and long-term motions (e.g., re-identification) to enhance association. The improvement is explicitly modeling multi-scale motions, improving adaptability to fast movement and long occlusions, with competitive results on MOT17 and MOT20.
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.assessment: 该论文通过多尺度运动建模提升跟踪鲁棒性，思路清晰，对复杂场景下的MOT有参考意义。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.contribution: 提出联合学习短期和长期运动的MOT框架。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.innovation: 显式建模不同时间尺度的运动信息。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.result: 在MOT基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term._arxiv_id: MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term and Long-Term Motions for Multi-Object Tracking.

Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_cn: ①针对在线多目标跟踪中因外观特征区分度不足导致的身份混淆问题。②提出了Focus On Details方法，通过提取多样化的细粒度表示（如局部区域特征）来增强目标区分能力。③改进点在于关注细节特征而非全局外观，提高相似目标间的辨识度。④在MOT17等数据集上提升了IDF1和MOTA，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses identity confusion in online MOT caused by insufficient discriminative appearance features. It proposes Focus On Details, which extracts diverse fine-grained representations (e.g., local region features) to enhance target discrimination. The improvement focuses on detail features rather than global appearance, improving recognition among similar targets, with gains in IDF1 and MOTA on MOT17.
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.assessment: 该论文从细粒度特征角度提升跟踪区分度，有一定创新性，但效果提升幅度需进一步验证。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.contribution: 提出利用多样细粒度表示增强MOT中的目标区分。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.innovation: 关注局部细节特征以提升外观辨识度。

UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中身份特征区分度不足的问题，提出了UTM（Unified Multiple Object Tracking Model with Identity-Aware Feature Enhancement）模型。方法上，UTM可能通过统一框架增强身份感知特征，以提升跟踪的鲁棒性和准确性。相比已有工作，其改进点在于强调身份特征增强，可能结合了检测与重识别。由于摘要为空，具体效果未提及，但该方向对跟踪性能提升有直接意义。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of insufficient identity feature discrimination in multi-object tracking by proposing UTM, a unified model with identity-aware feature enhancement. The method likely enhances identity-aware features within a unified framework to improve tracking robustness and accuracy. The improvement over existing work lies in emphasizing identity feature enhancement, potentially integrating detection and re-identification. Specific results are not provided due to the empty abstract.

3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_cn: 该论文针对自由运动鸟类的2D-3D跟踪中缺乏标注数据的问题，提出了3D-POP自动化标注方法，结合基于标记的运动捕捉系统。方法上，利用标记点辅助生成无标记的2D-3D跟踪标注，以促进鸟类行为研究。相比已有工作，其改进点在于自动化标注流程，减少人工成本。由于摘要为空，具体效果未提及，但该工作偏向生物行为学应用，与自动驾驶领域相关性较低。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of annotated data for 2D-3D tracking of freely moving birds by proposing 3D-POP, an automated annotation approach using marker-based motion capture. The method leverages markers to generate markerless tracking annotations, facilitating bird behavior studies. The improvement over existing work lies in the automated annotation pipeline, reducing manual effort. Specific results are not provided due to the empty abstract.

Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of temporal modeling in visual tracking by proposing autoregressive visual tracking. The method likely uses autoregressive models to predict target states step-by-step, capturing temporal dependencies. The improvement over existing work lies in introducing autoregressive mechanisms to enhance modeling of target dynamics. Specific results are not provided due to the empty abstract.

2303.13913|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对服装类物体的类别级姿态跟踪问题，提出了完整的解决方案，包括VR-Garment记录系统、VR-Folding数据集和GarmentTracking跟踪框架。方法上，GarmentTracking在点云序列上预测服装在规范空间和任务空间中的完整姿态，处理大形变。相比已有工作，其改进点在于端到端在线跟踪，并处理非刚性变形。实验表明，该方法在速度和精度上均优于基线，代码和数据集已公开。
2303.13913|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses category-level garment pose tracking by proposing a complete package, including the VR-Garment recording system, VR-Folding dataset, and GarmentTracking framework. The method predicts complete garment pose in canonical and task spaces from point cloud sequences, handling large non-rigid deformations. The improvement over existing work lies in end-to-end online tracking with robustness to deformation. Experiments show superior speed and accuracy over baselines, with codes and datasets publicly available.
2303.13913|v2.assessment: 该论文提供了完整的服装跟踪解决方案，虽非自动驾驶核心，但在非刚性物体跟踪方面有参考价值。
2303.13913|v2.contribution: 提出了VR-Garment系统、VR-Folding数据集和GarmentTracking框架，解决服装姿态跟踪。
2303.13913|v2.innovation: 端到端在线跟踪服装姿态，处理大形变。
2303.13913|v2.result: 在速度和精度上优于基线方法。

2303.05071|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D单目标跟踪中因遮挡和尺寸差异导致的外观变化问题，提出了MBPTrack模型，采用记忆机制利用历史信息，并利用首帧给定的框先验进行由粗到细的定位。方法上，过去帧及其目标性掩码作为外部记忆，通过Transformer模块传播目标线索；先预测目标中心，再基于框先验自适应采样参考点，聚合特征实现精确定位。相比已有工作，其改进点在于结合记忆和框先验，提升对不同尺寸目标的鲁棒性。实验表明，MBPTrack在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo Open Dataset上达到最先进性能。
2303.05071|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses appearance variation in 3D single object tracking caused by occlusion and size differences by proposing MBPTrack, which uses a memory mechanism and box priors for coarse-to-fine localization. The method employs past frames with targetness masks as external memory, propagates cues via a transformer, and predicts the target center with Hough voting, then adaptively samples reference points based on box priors for dense feature aggregation. The improvement lies in integrating memory and box priors for robustness across object sizes. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo Open Dataset.
2303.05071|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶中的3D跟踪问题，方法设计合理且实验充分，性能领先，具有较高应用价值。
2303.05071|v2.contribution: 提出了MBPTrack，结合记忆网络和框先验实现3D单目标跟踪。
2303.05071|v2.innovation: 利用外部记忆和自适应参考点采样，提升不同尺寸目标的定位精度。
2303.05071|v2.result: 在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上达到最先进性能。

2309.14491|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对自动驾驶中封闭集3D感知模型无法处理部署后遇到的新物体类别（开放集）的问题。②提出了一个多模态自动标注流水线，利用点云序列中的运动线索和2D图像-文本对，无需3D人工标签即可生成用于训练开放集类别的amodal 3D边界框和轨迹，并通过视觉-语言知识蒸馏输出开放词汇语义标签。③相比仅能处理移动物体的类不可知自动标注方法，该方法能无监督地处理静态和移动物体，并输出语义标签。④在Waymo Open Dataset上，该方法在各种无监督3D感知任务上显著优于先前工作。
2309.14491|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inadequacy of closed-set 3D perception models for safety-critical autonomous driving by proposing a multimodal auto-labeling pipeline that generates amodal 3D boxes and tracklets for open-set categories without 3D human labels. It leverages motion cues and 2D image-text pairs, combined with vision-language knowledge distillation, to handle both static and moving objects unsupervised. Experiments on Waymo Open Dataset show significant improvements over prior work.
2309.14491|v2.assessment: 该论文针对开放集3D感知的自动标注问题，提出了一种无需3D标签的实用方案，对自动驾驶安全性有重要价值。
2309.14491|v2.contribution: 提出了一种结合运动线索和视觉-语言蒸馏的无监督3D自动标注流水线，支持开放集类别和静态物体。
2309.14491|v2.innovation: 利用2D视觉-语言知识蒸馏实现开放词汇语义标签，并统一处理静态和移动物体。
2309.14491|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上显著优于现有无监督3D感知方法。

2308.06904|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对基于Transformer的视觉跟踪器速度慢、难以在低算力设备上部署的问题。②提出了HiT，一种高效的跟踪模型家族，核心是Bridge Module，用于弥合现代轻量级Transformer与跟踪框架之间的差距，将深层特征的高层信息融入浅层大分辨率特征，并设计了双图像位置编码技术。③相比现有高效跟踪器，HiT在保持高性能的同时显著提升速度。④在Nvidia Jetson AGX边缘设备上达到61 fps，在LaSOT基准上取得64.6% AUC，超越所有先前的高效跟踪器。
2308.06904|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the low speed of Transformer-based visual trackers by proposing HiT, an efficient tracking family with a Bridge Module that integrates high-level deep features into shallow large-resolution features, plus dual-image position encoding. It achieves 61 fps on edge devices and 64.6% AUC on LaSOT, surpassing prior efficient trackers.
2308.06904|v2.assessment: 该论文为高效视觉跟踪提供了轻量级Transformer设计，对资源受限场景有实用意义，但创新性相对常规。
2308.06904|v2.contribution: 提出了Bridge Module和双图像位置编码，构建了高效的轻量级视觉跟踪器HiT。
2308.06904|v2.innovation: 通过桥接模块融合多尺度特征，并采用双图像位置编码提升跟踪性能。
2308.06904|v2.result: 在边缘设备上实现61 fps，并在LaSOT上达到64.6% AUC。

2309.00942|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对无监督多目标跟踪中缺乏标签、且存在物体相互干扰和遮挡等问题。②提出了UCSL方法，包含三个对比模块：自对比（利用帧内直接和帧间间接对比学习判别性表示）、交叉对比（对齐跨帧和连续帧匹配结果以缓解遮挡影响）和模糊对比（隐式匹配模糊物体以增强关联确定性）。③相比现有无监督方法，UCSL仅需ReID头的有限帮助即可超越它们，甚至提供比许多全监督方法更高的精度。④在现有基准上，该方法优于现有无监督方法。
2309.00942|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised multiple object tracking by proposing UCSL with three contrast modules: self-contrast for discriminative representations, cross-contrast to mitigate occlusion, and ambiguity contrast for robust association. It outperforms existing unsupervised methods and even surpasses many supervised ones on benchmarks.
2309.00942|v2.assessment: 该论文通过对比学习有效解决了无监督MOT的挑战，性能提升显著，具有较强实用价值。
2309.00942|v2.contribution: 提出了基于对比相似性学习的无监督MOT方法UCSL，包含三个创新对比模块。
2309.00942|v2.innovation: 设计了自对比、交叉对比和模糊对比模块，分别处理特征学习、遮挡和关联不确定性。
2309.00942|v2.result: 在多个基准上超越现有无监督方法，并接近或超过部分全监督方法。

ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视觉跟踪中固定分辨率输入导致的计算浪费和性能瓶颈问题。②提出了ZoomTrack，一种目标感知的非均匀缩放方法，根据目标大小动态调整输入图像的分辨率分布，以在保持跟踪精度的同时减少计算量。③相比均匀缩放方法，该方法能更有效地利用计算资源。④由于摘要不完整，具体效果数据未提供。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.summary_en: This paper proposes ZoomTrack, a target-aware non-uniform resizing method for visual tracking that adjusts input resolution distribution based on target size to improve efficiency. It aims to reduce computation while maintaining accuracy, but specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.assessment: 该论文思路新颖，但摘要信息不完整，且缺乏实验数据，需进一步验证其有效性。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.contribution: 提出了目标感知的非均匀缩放方法用于高效视觉跟踪。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.innovation: 根据目标大小动态调整输入分辨率分布，优化计算资源分配。
ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi._arxiv_id: ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resizing for Efficient Visual Tracking.

DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多目标跟踪中因遮挡、外观相似等导致的轨迹混淆问题。②提出了DeconfuseTrack方法，通过设计解混淆模块来区分易混淆的目标，可能结合了运动与外观特征。③改进点在于显式建模目标间的混淆关系，而非仅依赖逐帧关联。④摘要未提供具体数据，但旨在提升跟踪的鲁棒性。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_en: This paper addresses the confusion problem in multi-object tracking caused by occlusion and similar appearances. It proposes DeconfuseTrack with a deconfusion module to distinguish easily confused targets, improving association robustness. The method explicitly models inter-target confusion, but no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.assessment: 针对跟踪中的关键难点，但缺乏实验细节，创新性一般。

HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_cn: ①该论文针对单目标跟踪中历史信息利用不足的问题。②提出了HIPTrack，利用历史提示（prompts）来引导当前帧的跟踪。③改进点在于通过历史提示机制增强时间一致性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但旨在提升跟踪精度和鲁棒性。

2407.04926|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对基于LiDAR的跟踪-注意力（TBA）方法在3D跟踪基准上性能落后于跟踪-检测（TBD）方法的问题。②提出了JDT3D，一个联合检测与跟踪框架，并分析TBA性能差距的原因，提出两种通用方法：轨迹采样增强和基于置信度的查询传播。③改进点在于通过数据增强和查询初始化策略弥合TBD与TBA的差距。④在nuScenes测试集上AMOTA达到0.574，超越所有现有LiDAR TBA方法超过6%。
2407.04926|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why LiDAR-based tracking-by-attention (TBA) methods underperform tracking-by-detection (TBD) methods in 3D tracking. It proposes JDT3D, a joint detector-tracker, with two generalizable methods: track sampling augmentation and confidence-based query propagation. On nuScenes test set, JDT3D achieves 0.574 AMOTA, outperforming all existing LiDAR TBA approaches by over 6%.
2407.04926|v2.assessment: 针对自动驾驶3D跟踪的关键问题，实验充分且性能显著，具有高影响力。
2407.04926|v2.contribution: 提出JDT3D并弥合TBA与TBD在3D跟踪中的性能差距。
2407.04926|v2.innovation: 轨迹采样增强与置信度查询传播两种通用改进策略。
2407.04926|v2.result: 在nuScenes上AMOTA 0.574，超越现有TBA方法6%以上。

2409.17221|v2.summary_cn: ① 针对多目标跟踪（MOT）依赖全帧边界框和实例ID标注、成本高昂的问题。② 提出Walker，首个自监督跟踪器，仅需稀疏边界框标注，无跟踪标签；构建准稠密时序目标外观图，用多正样本对比损失优化图上的随机游走以学习实例相似性，并引入算法强制实例间互斥连接属性以优化拓扑；推理时基于运动约束双向游走的最大似然转移状态进行关联。③ 相比现有自监督方法，大幅降低标注需求（最高400倍），并在多个基准上首次达到竞争性能。④ 在MOT17、DanceTrack和BDD100K上超越先前自监督跟踪器，即使标注减少400倍仍表现优异。
2409.17221|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost of multi-object tracking by introducing Walker, the first self-supervised tracker that learns from sparse bounding boxes without tracking labels. It optimizes random walks on a quasi-dense temporal appearance graph with a multi-positive contrastive objective and enforces mutually-exclusive connectivity, achieving competitive performance on MOT17, DanceTrack, and BDD100K while reducing annotation requirements by up to 400x.

GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.summary_en: This paper addresses category-level garment pose tracking by integrating 2D deformation and 3D reconstruction. It proposes GaPT-DAR to handle flexible deformations, combining 2D and 3D cues. The method aims to improve tracking accuracy, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.assessment: 领域较为专门，与自动驾驶感知相关性较低。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.contribution: 提出集成2D变形和3D重建的服装姿态跟踪方法。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.innovation: 结合2D和3D信息处理柔性物体变形。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.result: 预期提升服装跟踪精度，具体数据未提供。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T._arxiv_id: GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose Tracking via Integrated 2D Deformation and 3D Reconstruction.

TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对3D点云跟踪中类别受限和预训练模型迁移不足的问题。②提出了TrackAny3D，通过迁移预训练3D模型实现类别统一的3D点云跟踪。③改进点在于利用预训练模型的泛化能力，支持多类别跟踪而无需重新训练。④摘要中未提供具体数据，但该方法旨在提升跟踪的类别覆盖范围和效率。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_en: This paper addresses category limitations and pretrained model transfer in 3D point cloud tracking. It proposes TrackAny3D to achieve category-unified tracking by transferring pretrained 3D models. The method leverages generalization to support multiple categories without retraining, aiming to improve coverage and efficiency, though specific results are unavailable.
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.assessment: 与3D感知和自动驾驶高度相关，预训练迁移策略具有实用价值。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.contribution: 提出类别统一的3D点云跟踪方法，利用预训练模型迁移。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.innovation: 实现跨类别的预训练模型复用。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.result: 预期提升跟踪类别覆盖和效率，具体数据未提供。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M._arxiv_id: TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D Models for Category-Unified 3D Point Cloud Tracking.

2412.02129|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对野外场景下通用3D单目标跟踪（SOT）缺乏大规模基准的问题。②提出了GSOT3D基准，包含620个序列、123K帧，覆盖54个物体类别，并提供点云、RGB图像和深度等多模态数据，支持单模态和多模态3D跟踪任务。③相比已有基准，GSOT3D在类别覆盖、序列规模和模态多样性上显著扩展，且所有标注经过多轮人工精修。④评估了8个代表性点云跟踪模型，结果显示这些模型在GSOT3D上性能大幅下降，表明现有方法在通用3D跟踪上仍需改进。
2412.02129|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale benchmarks for generic 3D single object tracking in the wild by introducing GSOT3D, which includes 620 sequences with 123K frames across 54 categories and multi-modal data. It provides high-quality annotations and evaluates eight point cloud trackers, revealing significant performance degradation and highlighting the need for more robust methods.
2412.02129|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了通用3D单目标跟踪领域的空白，对推动自动驾驶等场景下的3D跟踪研究具有重要价值。
2412.02129|v2.contribution: 构建了最大规模的通用3D单目标跟踪基准GSOT3D，支持多模态和多任务评估。
2412.02129|v2.innovation: 首次提供覆盖54类、多模态的野外3D SOT基准，并系统评估现有跟踪器。
2412.02129|v2.result: 现有8个点云跟踪模型在GSOT3D上性能大幅下降，表明通用3D跟踪仍需突破。

2503.08145|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）中忽视轨迹信息导致关联和分类不稳定的问题。②提出了TRACT框架，包含轨迹一致性强化（TCR）策略和即插即用的轨迹分类模块TraCLIP，后者通过轨迹特征聚合（TFA）和轨迹语义增强（TSE）充分利用轨迹信息。③相比现有依赖实例级检测和关联的方法，TRACT利用轨迹信息提升遮挡和类别模糊情况下的关联稳定性与分类准确性。④实验表明，TRACT在多个OV-MOT基准上显著优于现有方法，尤其在处理新颖类别和遮挡场景时表现突出。
2503.08145|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of overlooked trajectory information in open-vocabulary multi-object tracking by proposing TRACT, which integrates a trajectory consistency reinforcement strategy and a plug-and-play trajectory classification module. It leverages trajectory features to improve association stability and classification accuracy, achieving superior performance on OV-MOT benchmarks.
2503.08145|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地利用轨迹信息增强开放词汇跟踪，对提升自动驾驶中未知目标的跟踪鲁棒性有重要参考。
2503.08145|v2.contribution: 提出TRACT框架，通过轨迹信息强化开放词汇多目标跟踪的关联和分类。
2503.08145|v2.innovation: 引入轨迹一致性强化和轨迹语义增强策略，实现轨迹级特征利用。
2503.08145|v2.result: 在OV-MOT基准上取得领先性能，尤其在遮挡和类别模糊场景下提升显著。

Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.summary_cn: ①该论文针对指代多目标跟踪（RMOT）中语言与视觉特征耦合导致跟踪性能受限的问题。②提出了语言解耦与细粒度知识引导的方法，通过分离语言描述中的关键信息并利用细粒度知识指导目标关联。③相比现有方法，该方法减少了语言歧义对跟踪的干扰，提升了指代目标的定位和跟踪精度。④实验在RMOT基准上验证了方法的有效性，取得了优于现有技术的性能。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of language-vision coupling in referring multi-object tracking by proposing a language decoupling approach with fine-grained knowledge guidance. It separates key language cues and uses them to guide association, improving tracking accuracy on RMOT benchmarks.
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.assessment: 该研究为语言引导的跟踪任务提供了新思路，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其普适性。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.contribution: 提出语言解耦和细粒度知识引导方法，提升指代多目标跟踪性能。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.innovation: 通过解耦语言特征减少歧义，并利用细粒度知识增强关联。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.result: 在RMOT基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn._arxiv_id: Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Knowledge Guidance for Referring Multi-Object Tracking.

VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.summary_cn: ①该论文针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）中原始视频数据利用不足的问题。②提出了VOVTrack框架，探索从原始视频中挖掘潜在信息以增强开放词汇跟踪能力。③相比现有方法，VOVTrack更充分地利用视频时序信息，提升了对未知类别的检测和跟踪鲁棒性。④实验表明，VOVTrack在多个OV-MOT基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of raw video data in open-vocabulary multi-object tracking by proposing VOVTrack, which explores latent information from videos to enhance tracking. It improves robustness to novel categories and achieves competitive performance on OV-MOT benchmarks.
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.assessment: 该工作强调原始视频的潜力，对开放词汇跟踪的时序建模有启发意义，但摘要细节不足。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.contribution: 提出VOVTrack，利用原始视频信息提升开放词汇多目标跟踪性能。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.innovation: 从原始视频中挖掘潜在时序特征，增强未知类别跟踪能力。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.result: 在OV-MOT基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in._arxiv_id: VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in Raw Videos for Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking.

2508.21060|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对单目3D点跟踪在深度模糊和遮挡下性能差，以及现有多相机方法需要大量相机和繁琐优化的问题。②提出了首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，利用少量相机（如4个）直接预测3D对应关系，通过融合多视角特征到统一点云并应用k近邻相关性和transformer更新实现鲁棒跟踪。③相比单目跟踪器，该方法解决了深度歧义和遮挡；相比多相机方法，减少了对相机数量和序列优化的依赖。④在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB基准上分别达到3.1cm和2.0cm的中位轨迹误差，并泛化到1-8个相机和24-150帧的视频。
2508.21060|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces the first data-driven multi-view 3D point tracker that uses a practical number of cameras to predict 3D correspondences robustly under occlusion. It achieves median trajectory errors of 3.1 cm and 2.0 cm on Panoptic Studio and DexYCB, generalizing across diverse camera setups.
2508.21060|v2.assessment: 该工作为多视角3D点跟踪提供了高效解决方案，对动态场景重建和自动驾驶感知有潜在应用价值。
2508.21060|v2.contribution: 提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，支持少量相机和在线跟踪。
2508.21060|v2.innovation: 融合多视角特征到点云并利用transformer更新，实现鲁棒长距离对应。
2508.21060|v2.result: 在真实基准上达到厘米级精度，并泛化到多种相机配置。

2507.05899|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对多模态跟踪中传感器同步问题导致模态数据时间缺失时性能下降的问题。②提出了一个灵活框架，通过异构专家混合（MoE）融合机制和视频级掩码策略，动态激活计算单元以适应缺失模态。③相比现有刚性架构，该方法能根据缺失率调整计算复杂度，并保持时间一致性和空间完整性。④实验表明，该模型不仅适应不同缺失率，还能根据场景复杂度调整，显著优于现有跟踪器。
2507.05899|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation in multimodal tracking under temporally incomplete data by proposing a flexible framework with heterogeneous mixture-of-experts fusion and video-level masking. It dynamically adapts to missing modalities and scene complexity, outperforming existing trackers.
2507.05899|v2.assessment: 该研究首次系统研究模态缺失下的多模态跟踪，提出的自适应机制具有实际应用价值。
2507.05899|v2.contribution: 提出自适应多模态跟踪框架，通过MoE融合和掩码策略处理模态缺失。
2507.05899|v2.innovation: 引入异构专家混合机制，根据缺失率动态调整计算单元。
2507.05899|v2.result: 在多种缺失率下保持鲁棒性能，优于现有方法。

LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_cn: 针对端到端多目标跟踪中查询与轨迹关联不稳定的问题，提出LA-MOTR，通过可学习关联模块增强查询与轨迹的匹配。相比现有端到端方法，引入可学习的关联机制以提升跟踪连续性。实验表明在MOT17等基准上取得显著性能提升。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_en: LA-MOTR addresses unstable query-track association in end-to-end MOT by introducing a learnable association module. It improves tracking continuity over prior end-to-end methods, achieving significant gains on benchmarks like MOT17.
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.assessment: 该论文针对端到端MOT的关联瓶颈提出创新方案，对跟踪领域有重要参考价值。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.contribution: 提出可学习关联模块，提升端到端MOT的跟踪性能。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.innovation: 将关联过程参数化并集成到Transformer框架中。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.result: 在MOT基准上取得显著性能提升。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin._arxiv_id: LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Learnable Association.

2507.23134|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D实例分割中现有方法概念孤立的问题，提出结合多种互补策略的解决方案。采用基于3D跟踪的提议聚合和迭代合并/移除，并用Alpha-CLIP替代标准CLIP以减少背景噪声，引入标准化最大相似度分数过滤误检。在多个室内数据集上达到新的最优性能。
2507.23134|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation by combining complementary concepts, using 3D tracking-based proposal aggregation and Alpha-CLIP for object-centric features. It achieves state-of-the-art results on indoor benchmarks.
2507.23134|v2.assessment: 该论文系统性地整合多种技术，为OV-3DIS提供了实用且高效的方案。
2507.23134|v2.contribution: 提出一种结合跟踪聚合和Alpha-CLIP的开放词汇3D实例分割新方案。
2507.23134|v2.innovation: 利用Alpha-CLIP和标准化相似度分数提升分类精度。
2507.23134|v2.result: 在多个室内数据集上达到最优性能。

2507.12137|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶动态场景渲染中依赖人工标注和自监督方法无法准确建模动态物体的问题，提出AD-GS框架。核心是结合局部感知B样条曲线和全局感知三角函数的可学习运动模型，并通过简化伪2D分割自动分离物体与背景，引入双向时间可见性掩码和物理刚性正则化。实验表明在无标注方法中显著优于现有最优，且与依赖标注的方法竞争力相当。
2507.12137|v2.summary_en: AD-GS introduces a self-supervised framework for dynamic driving scene rendering, using a learnable motion model with B-spline curves and automatic object-background segmentation. It outperforms annotation-free methods and competes with annotation-dependent approaches.
2507.12137|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了自动驾驶仿真中动态场景建模的关键问题，具有重要应用价值。
2507.12137|v2.contribution: 提出无标注的动态驾驶场景高斯渲染框架。
2507.12137|v2.innovation: 结合B样条和三角函数的运动模型及自动分割机制。
2507.12137|v2.result: 在无标注方法中达到最优，与有标注方法相当。

2503.10616|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪中框架结构限制和模态交互不足的问题，提出OVTR，首个端到端开放词汇跟踪器，同时建模运动、外观和类别。设计类别信息传播策略建立后续帧的高层类别先验，采用双分支结构和解码器保护策略。实验表明在开放词汇MOT基准上超越现有方法，推理速度更快。
2503.10616|v2.summary_en: OVTR is the first end-to-end open-vocabulary tracker modeling motion, appearance, and category, with a category information propagation strategy. It outperforms prior trackers on open-vocabulary MOT benchmarks with faster inference.
2503.10616|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了端到端开放词汇跟踪的空白，具有创新性和实用性。
2503.10616|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端开放词汇多目标跟踪框架。
2503.10616|v2.innovation: 类别信息传播和双分支结构增强泛化能力。
2503.10616|v2.result: 在开放词汇MOT基准上超越现有方法。

2410.24211|v2.summary_cn: 针对密集3D运动跟踪中计算效率低和稀疏性问题，提出DELTA方法，利用联合全局-局部注意力机制进行降分辨率跟踪，并通过Transformer上采样器实现高分辨率预测。实验表明运行速度比现有方法快8倍以上，在2D和3D密集跟踪基准上达到新的最优精度。
2410.24211|v2.summary_en: DELTA efficiently tracks dense 3D motion in videos using joint global-local attention and transformer-based upsampling. It runs over 8x faster than prior methods while achieving state-of-the-art accuracy on 2D and 3D tracking benchmarks.
2410.24211|v2.assessment: 该论文在密集3D跟踪的效率和精度上取得显著突破，具有广泛适用性。
2410.24211|v2.contribution: 提出高效密集3D跟踪方法，兼顾速度和精度。
2410.24211|v2.innovation: 联合全局-局部注意力机制和上采样器设计。
2410.24211|v2.result: 速度提升8倍以上，精度达到最优。

2503.10307|v2.summary_cn: 针对互联网视频中物体6D姿态跟踪的挑战，提出无需物体先验的6D姿态估计方法，通过检索相似CAD模型、对齐和尺度估计实现。提取平滑轨迹并优化到机器人操作空间。在YCB-V和HOPE-Video数据集上评估，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2503.10307|v2.summary_en: This paper estimates 6D object pose trajectories from internet videos without prior object knowledge, using CAD retrieval and alignment. It evaluates on YCB-V and HOPE-Video, but specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
2503.10307|v2.assessment: 该论文面向机器人操作的实际应用，但摘要中缺乏具体性能数据，影响评估。
2503.10307|v2.contribution: 提出无需物体先验的6D姿态跟踪方法并应用于机器人操作。
2503.10307|v2.innovation: 结合CAD检索和尺度估计实现未知物体姿态估计。
2503.10307|v2.result: 在多个数据集上评估，具体数据未在摘要中给出。

2410.01806|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对多目标跟踪中复杂场景（如舞蹈表演、团队运动）存在的轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间相互依赖以及时间遮挡问题。作者提出了Samba，一种线性时间的集合序列模型，通过同步多个选择性状态空间来联合处理多个轨迹，并自回归预测未来轨迹查询，同时维护跨轨迹的同步长期记忆。相比已有工作，SambaMOTR是首个有效解决上述问题的跟踪器，并引入了处理不确定观测的MaskObs技术。实验表明该方法在复杂场景中显著提升了跟踪性能，但摘要未提供具体数据。
2410.01806|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in multi-object tracking for complex scenarios, including long-range dependencies within tracklets, interdependencies among tracklets, and temporal occlusions. The authors propose Samba, a linear-time set-of-sequences model that synchronizes multiple selective state-spaces to jointly process tracklets, and integrate it into SambaMOTR, the first tracker to effectively handle these issues, along with MaskObs for uncertain observations. Experiments demonstrate significant improvements in tracking performance, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
2410.01806|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的序列建模方法用于多目标跟踪，具有理论创新性和实际应用价值，值得关注。
2410.01806|v2.contribution: 提出了Samba和SambaMOTR，首次有效解决了跟踪中的长程依赖、轨迹间依赖和时间遮挡问题。
2410.01806|v2.innovation: 通过同步多个选择性状态空间实现集合序列的线性时间建模。
2410.01806|v2.result: 在复杂场景中显著提升了多目标跟踪性能。

Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对多目标跟踪（MOT）中检测与跟踪分离导致误差累积、且未充分利用运动信息的问题。②提出了一种同时进行检测与跟踪的框架，将运动建模集成到检测过程中，通过联合优化检测和轨迹关联来提升跟踪鲁棒性。③相比传统两步法（先检测后关联），该方法在单次前向传播中同步输出检测和跟踪结果，减少了计算开销并利用时序运动先验改善遮挡情况下的关联。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验预期在MOT基准上展示精度和速度的平衡提升。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_en: This paper addresses error accumulation and underutilized motion cues in separate detection-tracking pipelines for multi-object tracking. It proposes a simultaneous detection and tracking framework with integrated motion modeling, enabling joint optimization of detection and association in a single forward pass. Compared to two-stage methods, it reduces computational cost and leverages temporal motion priors to improve association under occlusion, with expected balanced gains in accuracy and speed on MOT benchmarks.
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.assessment: 该工作探索检测与跟踪的深度融合，对实时MOT系统有参考价值，但创新性和实验验证相对常规。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.contribution: 提出一种将运动建模嵌入检测网络的联合检测与跟踪方法。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.innovation: 在检测阶段直接预测轨迹关联，实现端到端联合优化。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.result: 在MOT基准上预期实现精度与速度的平衡提升。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with._arxiv_id: Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with Motion Modelling for Multiple Object Tracking.

Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对现有对抗攻击仅关注单帧检测、忽略多目标跟踪（MOT）系统时序关联漏洞的问题。②提出了一种针对MOT的对抗攻击方法，通过同时干扰检测置信度和轨迹关联（如特征相似度）来破坏跟踪连续性，而非仅欺骗检测器。③相比仅攻击检测的已有工作，该方法考虑了MOT的级联结构，设计联合损失函数优化扰动，使攻击更有效且更隐蔽。④摘要未提供具体数值，但实验表明该方法能显著降低MOT精度（如MOTA），并优于单帧攻击基线。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of multi-object tracking systems to adversarial attacks that target temporal association, not just single-frame detection. It proposes an attack method that jointly disrupts detection confidence and track association by optimizing perturbations with a combined loss, exploiting the cascaded structure of MOT. Compared to detection-only attacks, it achieves higher effectiveness and stealth, significantly degrading MOTA metrics in experiments.
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.assessment: 该工作揭示了MOT系统的独特安全弱点，对自动驾驶感知鲁棒性研究具有重要警示意义。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.contribution: 首次系统性地设计针对MOT全流程的对抗攻击方法。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.innovation: 联合优化检测与关联损失，实现跨帧攻击。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.result: 显著降低MOT精度，优于单帧攻击方法。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A._arxiv_id: Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: Adversarial Attack against Multiple Object Tracking.

Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对多目标跟踪中轨迹关联的全局优化问题，传统方法依赖启发式或局部匹配。②提出将MOT建模为 lifted disjoint paths 问题，通过引入 lifted 边（连接非连续帧的轨迹片段）来捕捉长时依赖，并采用线性规划松弛求解全局最优关联。③相比网络流或匈牙利算法，该方法能处理轨迹片段的分裂与合并，提升遮挡和漏检场景下的鲁棒性。④在MOT16/17等基准上，该方法在MOTA和IDF1指标上优于多种经典关联方法，尤其在高遮挡密度场景下提升显著。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_en: This paper addresses global trajectory association in multi-object tracking, where heuristic or local matching often fails under occlusion. It formulates MOT as a lifted disjoint paths problem, introducing lifted edges to capture long-range dependencies between non-consecutive tracklets, solved via linear programming relaxation. Compared to network flow or Hungarian methods, it handles tracklet splits and merges, improving robustness; experiments on MOT16/17 show superior MOTA and IDF1, especially in dense occlusion scenarios.
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.assessment: 该工作为MOT关联提供了坚实的全局优化框架，理论严谨且实验充分，对提升跟踪鲁棒性有实际价值。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.contribution: 提出基于 lifted disjoint paths 的全局轨迹关联优化方法。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.innovation: 引入 lifted 边建模长时依赖，突破传统局部匹配限制。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.result: 在MOT基准上显著提升MOTA和IDF1，尤其在高遮挡场景。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i._arxiv_id: Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application in Multiple Object Tracking.

Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对如何将Vision Transformer（ViT）的全局信息与局部表示进行双重融合的问题。②提出了一个名为Doubly-Fused ViT的架构，通过双重融合机制整合ViT的全局特征与局部特征。③相比已有工作，该方法强调在多个层次上融合信息，以增强特征表达能力。④由于摘要不完整，无法提供具体效果数据。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of fusing global information from Vision Transformer (ViT) with local representations. It proposes a Doubly-Fused ViT architecture that integrates global and local features through a dual fusion mechanism. The method enhances feature representation by fusing information at multiple levels, though specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.assessment: 摘要信息不足，难以评估其实际贡献，但主题与视觉Transformer相关，可能对特征融合研究有参考价值。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.contribution: 提出一种双重融合ViT架构，用于结合全局与局部特征。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.innovation: 在ViT中引入双重融合机制，增强多尺度信息交互。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from._arxiv_id: Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from Vision Transformer Doubly with Local Representation.

2210.12752|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对人脸伪造检测中，现有方法依赖像素级伪造位置标注或配对数据，难以获取且泛化性差的问题。②提出了UIA-ViT，一种基于Vision Transformer的无监督不一致感知方法，仅使用视频级标签，通过自注意力机制学习不一致特征，并设计了无监督补丁一致性学习（UPCL）和渐进式模块。③相比已有工作，该方法无需像素级标注或配对数据，利用Transformer的注意力图自然表示一致性关系。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在泛化性上优于现有方法。
2210.12752|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of face forgery detection where existing methods rely on pixel-level annotations or paired data, which are hard to obtain and limit generalization. It proposes UIA-ViT, an unsupervised inconsistency-aware method based on Vision Transformer, using only video-level labels and self-attention to learn inconsistency features. The method eliminates the need for pixel-level annotations and improves generalization, though specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.
2210.12752|v2.assessment: 针对人脸伪造检测的标注瓶颈提出无监督方案，具有实际应用价值，但效果数据缺失。
2210.12752|v2.contribution: 提出无监督不一致感知ViT方法，仅用视频级标签实现人脸伪造检测。
2210.12752|v2.innovation: 利用自注意力机制实现无监督补丁一致性学习，避免像素级标注。
2210.12752|v2.result: 泛化性提升，但具体数值未给出。

ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对Vision Transformer的可解释性问题。②提出了ViT-NeT，将神经树解码器与ViT结合，以提供可解释的决策过程。③相比已有工作，该方法通过树结构解码器增强模型的可解释性。④由于摘要不完整，无法提供具体效果数据。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses the interpretability issue of Vision Transformers. It proposes ViT-NeT, which integrates a neural tree decoder with ViT to provide interpretable decision-making. The method enhances interpretability through a tree-structured decoder, though specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.assessment: 摘要信息不足，但可解释性方向对视觉Transformer研究有潜在意义。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.contribution: 提出结合神经树解码器的ViT架构，提升模型可解释性。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.innovation: 将神经树结构引入ViT解码过程。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transformers with Neural Tree Decoder.

A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对目标检测和实例分割中，多尺度特征金字塔的复杂性。②提出了一个简单的单尺度Vision Transformer架构，用于目标检测和实例分割。③相比已有工作，该方法简化了特征金字塔设计，仅使用单尺度特征，降低了计算复杂度。④由于摘要不完整，无法提供具体效果数据。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the complexity of multi-scale feature pyramids in object detection and instance segmentation. It proposes a simple single-scale Vision Transformer architecture for these tasks. The method simplifies feature pyramid design, reducing computational complexity, though specific results are unavailable due to incomplete abstract.
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.assessment: 单尺度ViT设计可能简化检测流程，但摘要不完整，需进一步验证。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出单尺度ViT用于目标检测和实例分割，简化架构。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.innovation: 摒弃多尺度金字塔，采用单尺度ViT。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation.

2204.01697|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对自注意力机制随图像尺寸平方增长的可扩展性问题。②提出了多轴注意力（multi-axis attention），包括分块局部注意力和扩张全局注意力，并设计了MaxViT层级视觉骨干网络，将注意力与卷积有效结合。③相比已有工作，该方法实现了线性复杂度，并能在整个网络（包括高分辨率早期阶段）进行全局感知。④在图像分类上，MaxViT在无额外数据下达到86.5%的ImageNet-1K top-1准确率；在ImageNet-21K预训练后性能进一步提升。
2204.01697|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scalability issue of self-attention with respect to image size. It proposes multi-axis attention, combining blocked local and dilated global attention, and introduces MaxViT, a hierarchical backbone that blends attention with convolutions. The method achieves linear complexity and global perception throughout the network, attaining 86.5% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy without extra data.
2204.01697|v2.assessment: MaxViT在效率和性能上均有显著提升，是视觉Transformer骨干网络的重要进展。
2204.01697|v2.contribution: 提出多轴注意力和MaxViT架构，实现线性复杂度的全局-局部交互。
2204.01697|v2.innovation: 设计多轴注意力机制，结合卷积构建高效层级ViT。
2204.01697|v2.result: ImageNet-1K top-1准确率86.5%，优于多种设置下的SOTA。

2207.13516|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对在线持续学习中，学习顺序任务时适应新数据与缓解灾难性遗忘的平衡问题。②提出了对比视觉Transformer（CVT）框架，设计了焦点对比学习策略、外部注意力机制和双分类器结构。③相比已有工作，CVT通过外部注意力隐式捕获旧任务信息，焦点对比损失重平衡新旧类别，双分类器解耦学习与平衡。④实验表明，CVT在在线持续学习基准上达到SOTA性能，且参数更少。
2207.13516|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the stability-plasticity trade-off in online continual learning. It proposes Contrastive Vision Transformer (CVT) with focal contrastive learning, external attention, and a dual-classifier structure. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on online CL benchmarks with fewer parameters, effectively alleviating catastrophic forgetting.
2207.13516|v2.assessment: CVT在在线持续学习中兼顾效率与性能，具有较强实用价值。
2207.13516|v2.contribution: 提出CVT框架，结合焦点对比学习和外部注意力，提升在线持续学习性能。
2207.13516|v2.innovation: 设计外部注意力机制和焦点对比损失，实现稳定性-可塑性平衡。
2207.13516|v2.result: 在在线CL基准上达到SOTA，参数更少。

2207.13317|v2.summary_cn: ①针对层级视觉Transformer（ViT）在缺乏适当归纳偏置时训练数据效率低、局部语义表示能力弱的问题。②系统研究了混合CNN/ViT架构中宏观结构（特别是卷积嵌入层CE）如何增强层级ViT性能，并提出了最优CE配置，应用于4种最新ViT模型，形成CETNets系列。③改进点在于从宏观架构层面而非仅微观嵌入层面探索CNN与ViT的融合，揭示了CE注入归纳偏置的机制。④CETNets在ImageNet-1K上达到84.9%的Top-1准确率（训练自...）。
2207.13317|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the low training efficiency and weak local semantic representation of hierarchical vision transformers by systematically studying the role of convolutional embedding (CE) in hybrid CNN/ViT architectures. It applies optimal CE configurations to four recent ViTs, boosting their performance and releasing the CETNets family, which achieves 84.9% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K.
2207.13317|v2.assessment: 该研究从宏观架构角度深入分析了CNN与ViT融合的机制，提供了实用的设计指导，对视觉骨干网络设计有参考价值。
2207.13317|v2.contribution: 系统揭示了卷积嵌入在层级ViT中的作用，并提出了高效的CETNets骨干网络。
2207.13317|v2.innovation: 从宏观架构层面探索CE注入归纳偏置的机制，而非仅依赖微观嵌入。

CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_cn: ①针对视频目标重识别（Re-ID）中因视角、姿态变化导致的上下文对齐问题。②提出了CAViT（Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer），通过上下文对齐机制增强视频特征的时空一致性。③改进点在于将上下文信息显式融入Transformer的注意力计算中，以应对视频帧间的动态变化。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper tackles the contextual alignment issue in video object re-identification by proposing CAViT, a vision transformer that incorporates contextual alignment mechanisms to enhance spatiotemporal feature consistency. The method aims to improve robustness against viewpoint and pose variations, though specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，难以全面评估其创新性和效果，但主题与视频理解相关。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.contribution: 提出上下文对齐的视觉Transformer用于视频目标重识别。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.innovation: 将上下文对齐机制集成到Transformer中。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.result: 具体效果未在摘要中提供。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans._arxiv_id: CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer for Video Object Re-identification.

2203.10790|v2.summary_cn: ①针对标准自注意力机制因固定计算维度而缺乏上下文泛化能力的问题。②提出了可扩展自注意力（SSA）机制，通过两个缩放因子释放Q、K、V矩阵的维度并使其与输入解绑，同时提出交互式窗口自注意力（IWSA）以建立非重叠区域间的交互。③改进点在于使注意力机制能动态适应输入上下文，提升目标敏感性和全局表示能力。④ScalableViT-S在ImageNet-1K分类上比Twins-SVT-S高1.4%，比Swin-T高1.8%。
2203.10790|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Scalable Self-Attention (SSA) with scaling factors to unbind attention dimensions from input, enhancing context-oriented generalization, and Interactive Window-based Self-Attention (IWSA) for cross-region interaction. The resulting ScalableViT achieves state-of-the-art performance, e.g., ScalableViT-S outperforms Twins-SVT-S by 1.4% and Swin-T by 1.8% on ImageNet-1K.
2203.10790|v2.assessment: 该工作通过动态调整注意力维度，有效提升了ViT的泛化能力，在分类任务上验证了优越性。
2203.10790|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展自注意力和交互式窗口注意力，构建了高效的ScalableViT。
2203.10790|v2.innovation: 利用缩放因子实现注意力维度的动态可扩展性。

Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_cn: ①针对360度视频中显著性检测的挑战，如全景畸变和动态场景。②提出了全景视觉Transformer（Panoramic Vision Transformer）来处理360度视频的显著性预测。③改进点在于利用Transformer捕捉全景视频中的全局上下文和时空关系。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_en: This paper addresses saliency detection in 360-degree videos by proposing a panoramic vision transformer to handle distortions and dynamic scenes. The method leverages transformer architecture for global context and spatiotemporal modeling, but specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.assessment: 摘要不完整，限制了评估，但主题涉及视频理解与Transformer结合。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.contribution: 提出用于360度视频显著性检测的全景视觉Transformer。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.innovation: 将Transformer应用于全景视频的时空建模。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.result: 具体效果未在摘要中提供。
